programme.title: Helmet Heads
programme.desc: An easygoing bike messenger faces upheaval when he and his buddies are fired; when his girl Clara plans to move to a motorcycle-free island, the messenger forms a debt-collecting gang to win her back.

programme.title: Dogworld
programme.desc: In the near future, Taranto is a ghost town surrounded by barbed wire that no one, not even the police, dares to enter. The poorest are left fighting for survival, while a gang is competing for territory with another gang. Two thirteen-year-old orphans, who grew up together, dream of joining one of the gangs.

programme.title: The Butler
programme.desc: The Butler (2013) is an American historical drama directed by Lee Daniels and starring Forest Whitaker and Oprah Winfrey. At the White House an elderly butler named Cecil Gaines is waiting for the newly inaugurated president Barack Obama. While waiting, the butler recounts his life story and all the former US presidents he served. A butler's job requires keeping what you heard to yourself and doing your job unnoticed. Serving eight presidents during his tenure, Cecil observed how American society was changing and even he has felt these changes.

programme.title: Louise Violet
programme.desc: France. End of the 19th century. Louise Violet, a Parisian teacher, is sent on a mission to the French countryside. She has to impose the free, compulsory and secular school of the Republic.

programme.title: Old-fashioned
programme.desc: One island, 40 inhabitants, two scammers. On a picturesque island in Brittany, lifelong friends Jean-Jean (Didier Bourdon) and Henri (Gérard Darmon, Employee of the Month) find their quiet existence disrupted when one of their fellow villagers wins millions in the national lottery. The pair hatch a plan to befriend the lucky local and hopefully share in the winnings... only to find the winner has died of shock - ticket in hand! Jean-Jean and Henri must devise another scheme. In order to claim the prize, the friends will simply steal the unlucky winner's identity... However, the pair soon realise that to fool the lottery officials in such a small town, they'll have to convince the villagers - who all want a piece of the pie - to back their daring plan. Jean-Jean and Henri are out to prove that you're never too old to raise a little hell in this crowd-pleasing comedy, a remake of the Irish classic Waking Ned Devine. With a winning blend of absurdity and heart, you'll fall in love with the stunning sights of Brittany and its colourful characters. This charming story shows what a community can achieve when they come together (yes, even fraud).

programme.title: Aliens Abducted My Parents and Now I Feel Kinda Left Out
programme.desc: Itsy is new in town and her life seems over until she meets her space-obsessed neighbor Calvin, who believes his parents were abducted by aliens. An aspiring journalist, Itsy decides to write an exposé on Calvin but ends up discovering much more.

programme.title: Vera Drake
programme.desc: Vera Drake is a selfless woman who is completely dedicated to her working class family who love her. He spends his days adoring them, and also takes care of his sick neighbor and old mother. And he secretly visits women and helps them have abortions. Something like that was illegal in England in the 1950s. Vera sees it as helping women in need, and she does it with a smile on her face and words of encouragement. However, when the authorities discover her, Vera's world and family life quickly unravel.

programme.title: The Time of Secrets
programme.desc: Marcel Pagnol embarks on his last summer vacation before high school and returns to his beloved hills in Provence. His summer of boyhood adventures becomes one of first loves and secrets.

programme.title: Look of Nothing (Mine de rien)
programme.desc: In a small town in the North of France, a region that was the flagship of the mining industry for many years, young and old alike are struggling to find work. While several former workers decide to hold a siege in front of a disused coal mine that is to be dismantled, two long-term unemployed men, Di Lello, whose wife runs the household, and Arnaud, a divorced man who has to take care of his sick mother, have the excellent idea of building an "artisanal" amusement park. By saving the mine and its memory, they will regain strength and dignity.

programme.title: The Fabulous Patars
programme.desc: After the death of his beloved spouse, Denis, a loving father, is struggling with the education of his two daughters, Jenine and Mercredi, and his two jobs. When he forgets to pick Mercredi up from school, the director calls the social services. Severine, a social investigator, forces Denis to attend parenting classes, under penalty of withdrawing the custody of his daughters…

programme.title: Tenor
programme.desc: While working part-time as a food deliveryman, Antoine, an aspiring young rapper from the suburbs of Paris, meets Mrs. Loiseau, an eminent teacher at the Paris Opéra. Stunned by the young man's raw talent, she introduces him to the world of opera. As Antoine becomes one of Mrs. Loiseau's students, he hides his new dream from his friends and family, fearing that they won't understand - this double life burdens him... Somewhere in between the gilded and uptight Parisian upper-class, and the harsh yet free-spirited and familiar suburbs he grew up in, Antoine will have to find his own voice.

programme.title: Teddy Bear
programme.desc: Drama. At first glance, Dennis appears as a massive bodybuilder champion. Upon a closer look, one can quickly realise that inside the 38-year-old man lies a small kid, trapped in the world built for him by his authoritarian mother.

programme.title: Investigating Sex
programme.desc: A group of men and two female stenographers scientifically study sex.

programme.title: God Help the Girl
programme.desc: Emily Browning, Olly Alexander, Hannah Murray and Pierre Boulanger star in first-time screenwriter-director Stuart Murdoch's romantic musical. Murdoch is lead singer and songwriter of Scottish band Belle and Sebastian, and this movie sprang from his side-project album showcasing songs about and sung by women. Browning plays (and sings) the lead role of Eve, an aspiring singer and musician who struggles with an eating disorder and depression. Attending a gig in Glasgow, Eve meets nerdy singer-songwriter James (Alexander), who works as a university lifeguard and teaches guitar. When she gets stranded in the city, he puts her up for the night and the two strike up a friendship that promises romance. They form a band with Cassie (Murray), one of James's guitar students, and together they strive to achieve their dream of stardom. But Eve's friendship with Anton (Boulanger), the frontman of up-and-coming band Wobbly-Legged Rat will cause a series of problems. With Mark Radcliffe, Stuart Maconie and Josie Long.

programme.title: How He Fell in Love
programme.desc: Travis, a struggling young musician, crosses paths with Ellen, an older, married yoga instructor who is in the process of adopting a child. Travis and Ellen begin an affair that slowly deepens into something more intimate and profound. As their encounters continue, Travis must face the consequences of infidelity while Ellen is confronted with her crumbling marriage.

programme.title: Tanked
programme.desc: Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. At Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the brothers-in-law guide you through the design process and the building of their truly jaw-dropping aquariums. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele.

programme.title: Animal Cops: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Animal Cops: Philadelphia follows the work of the Pennsylvania SPCA's Humane Law Enforcement team as they investigate cases of animal cruelty; rescue sick and abused animals and fight for justice on their behalf. The Pennsylvania SPCA's humane law enforcement officers cover an area of over 46,000 square miles from their headquarters in Philadelphia. The six offic ers with full police powers and six agent trainees are on call 24 hours a day seven days a week protecting the city's one and a half million pets.

programme.title: Immersion
programme.desc: The Immersion crew answers a wide range of shark-fuelled questions by taking some of the most iconic shark moments from pop culture history and bringing them to real life.

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People
programme.desc: Alaskan Bush People is an American docudrama-style reality TV series revolving around the Brown family, members of which are trying to survive in the wilderness, far away from the society. Take a journey deep into Alaska's bush, where naturalist and adventurer Billy Brown, along with his wife, Ami, and their seven children, choose to live life on their own terms, connected to wild nature and bonded to each other.

programme.title: My Cat from Hell
programme.desc: Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
programme.desc: US reality TV show follows the Irwin family through their adventures in continuing Steve Irwin's legacy. The family share their wildlife experiences from their travels across the world. They show how they care for all the animals while giving insight into their family life at Australia Zoo where they live and work. The Australian family including mother Terri who is a naturalist and conservationist stars alongside daughter Bindi and son Robert who are fully immerse in animal life and their family.

programme.title: The Zoo: San Diego
programme.desc: "The Zoo: San Diego" provides a behind the scenes look at the daily lives of various species of animals and the teams that care for them. Featuring two parks, the San Diego Zoo and the San Diego Zoo Safari Park, as well as the San Diego Zoo Institute for Conservation Research, San Diego Zoo Global is home to more than 700 species and 6,500 animals. A wide range of animals are introduced, including pandas, giraffes, Galapagos tortoises, koalas, elephants, mountain lions, two baby cheetahs that are learning how to be ambassadors for their species and a flock of ostriches known as the "Spice Girls." Besides the animals, the keepers and veterinarians at both the Zoo and the Safari Park -- many of whom have dedicated their lives to caring for animals, discuss what it's like to be a part of this world-renowned zoo.

programme.title: The Aquarium
programme.desc: Reality-documentary series following the lives of the aquatic inhabitants at the Georgia Aquarium. The largest in the United States and fourth-largest in the world, the aquarium boasts a wide range of diverse inhabitants and explores the relationship between animals and trainers. The 10-million-gallon (38-million-litre) facility plays home to over 500 marine species including endangered penguins, rescued sea otters and recovering sea lions. The show reveals the difficulties that come with nursing and caring for such a wide variety of species. With many heart-warming scenes, the series beautifully reveals the friendships between the different species and how they learn to co-exist with each other.

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
programme.desc: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet is a TV series entirely dedicated to love and care for animals. Thanks to a genius Dr. Jeff Young Denver's Planned Pethood Plus veterinary clinic is always busy and is taking care of 80,000-plus clients and their pets. Dr. Jeff's sharp surgical skills and his unconditional love for animals make him one of the most respected vets in the country. Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets.

programme.title: The Vet Life
programme.desc: The Vet Life is an amazing series revolving around three friends, three vets, Diarra Blue, Aubrey Ross, and Mike Lavigne and their everyday lives. These guys became friends back in University, then they worked in Las Vegas and finally moved to Texas and opened a full-service veterinary hospital of their own. The series highlights their daily routine, their duties at work and at home, their families and pets.

programme.title: Treehouse Masters
programme.desc: Treehouse Masters is an American reality television series hosted by Pete Nelson, a treehouse builder. Pete and his team design and build all types of treehouses for clients across the country. The clients and Pete's team are the people who never stop dreaming. You'll be surprised to know how many people want to get away from the noisy comfortable cities and live in close communion with mother nature. So getting a treehouse is their chance to live a dream. Every episode will amaze you because of Pete's talent and incredible imagination. He can build any type of a treehouse, starting from a small simple ones to most complex residences with all modern communication. Every wish of a customer will be heard and fulfilled.

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees
programme.desc: Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

Congdon and his crew renovate existing pools and build new ones on residential properties. Thanks to their unbelievable imagination, creativity and professionalism they can turn every pool into an ultimate backyard oasis for a whole family and transform it into a natural lagoon. They prefer working with hand-selected stones from Tennessee.

programme.title: Guardians of Rescue
programme.desc: Follow a group of men and women coming from a range of backgrounds, united in their love for animals and in their mission to rescue them, as well as educate and motivate people to follow their lead. Their main concern is helping animals in need, but it is also strengthening the bond with animals that has always been present in human lives, emphasising the importance of nurturing that relationship.

programme.title: I Was Prey
programme.desc: Nature's great predators are animals you don't want to come across, especially when you find yourself in their own backyard. In this heart-pumping documentary series, individuals share their stories of encounters with dangerous animals, reliving the frightful, life-threatening ordeal. With stories from across the world, we reveal the heart-in-mouth moments when these lucky individuals managed to escape the jaws of death. From a swimmer mauled by a bull shark in the Bahamas to a close shave with a grizzly bear in the mountains, these stories showcase the fearsome power of predators.

programme.title: Animal ER
programme.desc: The story follows the work of the dedicated staff of Gulf Coast veterinary clinic, an emergency animal hospital where patients that require critical care are treated by professionals trained to handle a variety of services, ranging from routine check-ups to extremely complex veterinary procedures.

programme.title: Rugged Justice
programme.desc: Animal Planet's Rugged Justice follows the officers from Washington State's Department of Fish and Wildlife Law Enforcement as they guard the vast borders. It is an elite unit that protect people and wildlife, patrolling coastal areas, mountainous terrains and rugged roads of rainforests. Every day brings a new challenge, dispatchers receive around 25.000 calls annually, every of which requires prompt reaction.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Dinner: Impossible
programme.desc: Robert Irvine travels to Asheville, N.C., to compete in the annual Asheville Food Truck Showdown. He and his team face off against three of the best food trucks in the state. With a $1,500 budget, the mission is to prepare enough food for 500 people and use beer in every dish, and the truck that makes the most money wins. Anything can happen as food truck novice Robert competes against seasoned teams who cook in food trucks every day.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

programme.desc: Join our hosts, renowned celebrity chefs and restaurateurs Bobby Flay and Michael Symon, as they test the skills of eight expert barbecue connoisseurs. Filmed at the Star Hill Ranch in Austin, Texas, the eight chefs are divided into two teams but, in order to claim first pick for their team, Bobby and Michael go head-to-head in a backyard BBQ challenge. Each episode sees one of the chefs being eliminated from the show until there is only one left, the winner who is awarded the title of 'Master of Cue'. The weekly contests aim to reveal the chefs' talents and expose their weaknesses and include tasks such as cooking up a tomahawk rib-eye and taking on a Texas beef challenge.

programme.title: Summer Baking Championship
programme.desc: Jesse Palmer challenges the bakers to create road trip portable desserts. Then, the bakers go glamping with glam summer cobblers.

programme.title: Girl Meets Farm
programme.desc: Molly Yeh puts together the coolest kids' brunch in town for Bernie's preschool buddies, and everyone in the family can enjoy! She serves up savory Breakfast Sausage Stuffed Biscuits with runny, sunny-side-up eggs and maple syrup for dunking. Then, she makes Strawberry Vanilla Bean Pastry Pockets drizzled with Cream Cheese Glaze and sprinkles, easy Spinach Egg Bites and Frozen Peanut Butter Drinks the kiddos and parents will both love!

programme.title: Girl Meets Farm
programme.desc: Molly Yeh is a cookbook author who combines her country lifestyle with her Jewish and Chinese heritage to create the most delicious new dishes. A former big city girl, Yeh is multi talented, a successful blogger and classically trained musician, its food that ultimately stole her heart. Learn lots of tricks and tips with Yeh as she cooks up her personal favourite recipes for every occasion, from family visits to brunch with the girls to a classic farm supper! This show is an absolute treat.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: The Drummond drive-through is open for business, and Ree Drummond is serving up the most sensational packed lunch known to cowboys. She starts with rib-sticking Ranch Hand Sandwiches Filled with Pop Pulled Pork and a bunch of tasty fixins, and a side of homemade Spicy Sweet Potato Chips are totally cowboy-approved. Ree rounds out her tasty take-out with a cup of refreshing Cowboy Fruit Salad with a subtle chili kick and triple-chocolate Cow Pies.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond is hosting brunch, and she's making things easy with a make-ahead party spread that's ready and in the fridge! First, she pulls together all the ingredients for an interactive and customized Bloody Mary Bar. Then, she knocks out a marvelous make-ahead dinner mashup of everyone's brunch favorites in her Tater Tot Breakfast Casserole. Ree whips up a fresh Citrus Salad with champagne vinegar dressing and pours Tropical Bellinis for the finishing touch on a stunning brunch with friends.

programme.title: Giada at Home
programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis is an outstanding culinary specialist, the author of nine New York Times bestselling cookbooks, Emmy award winning television personality and the host of Giada at Home television show. Giada has quite an impressive background of culinary training from Le Cordon Bleu in Paris, which combined with her own unique Californian charm creates her one-of-a-kind recognizable style. programme.title: Alaska Monsters
programme.desc: Within the Last Frontier lies a region known as the Alaska Triangle, spanning 200,000 unforgiving square miles where more people go missing per capita than anywhere else on earth. Treacherous terrain and unforgiving natural elements have stopped many in their tracks, but some Alaskans hold onto the idea that mysterious monsters snatched them up. Unidentified crypto-creatures wander the state covered by millions of acres of dense wilderness and are known to lift and reposition trees with ease, create seismic activity with their minds, and even decapitate humans with one bite. Destination America's new series ALASKA MONSTERS travels with a team of native outdoorsmen, who call themselves the Midnight Sons, as they investigate the harsh Alaskan forest in a quest to uncover proof of frightening monsters thought to be living there.

Every episode tells the story of a gruesome murder that happened in a small town. Delve into the heart of the cases through interviews with investigators, family members, prosecutors and neighbours. Various twists and turns can make you question reality, and the final outcome can surprise everyone involved. How well do you know the people next door?

programme.title: The Real Story with Maria Elena Salinas
programme.desc: Investigative journalist Maria Elena Salinas uses her years of experience to unearth new evidence in criminal cases that have made national headlines. Dubbed the "Voice of Hispanic America" by The New York Times, Maria has travelled the world, reporting on war crimes and interviewing heads of state, dictators, US Presidents and many notable politicians. This series sees Maria seeking truths about crimes committed on US soil, finding the evidence to overturn wrongful convictions, uncovering the clues to prosecute murderers and helping families find closure.

programme.title: On the Case with Paula Zahn
programme.desc: Documentary series presented by the journalist Paula Zahn. Speaking to people connected with real-life crimes and looking at actions surrounding these shocking events, Zahn aims to uncover the truth behind true crime cases.

programme.title: Married To Evil
programme.desc: Think you know the person you married? Think again. These gripping true stories explore the wickedness behind the wedding and show the devastating consequences of what happens when people are betrayed by those who should love them.

programme.title: Bodies In the Water
programme.desc: When a pregnant mother surfaces in the Hudson River, NYPD suspects foul play. As they dig deeper, they uncover a killer who's closer than they think.

programme.title: The Lake Erie Murders
programme.desc: Coming from the beautiful environs of Lake Erie, straddling the border between the US and Canada, this true life crime show focuses on the more sinister and gruesome tales of some of the region's darkest and deadliest crimes. We explore baffling and mysterious murder cases such as that of the 1989 kidnapping and murder of 10-year-old Amy Mihaljevic which provoked much speculation and intrigue in the area and which is still an open case. Each hourlong episode delves into the case history, analyzes the facts and evidence and carefully examines the detection procedures and how each suspect was cleared of suspicion. Subsequent episodes detail four additional deadly crimes that were solved by local law enforcement.

programme.title: American Chopper
programme.desc: American Chopper is an American reality television series that revolves around the Teutuls- Paul Senior, his sons Paul Junior and Michael who work together at Orange County Choppers, a custom motorcycle fabrication company located in Montgomery, New York. The series is a mix of competition and drama, famous for real fighting, cursing, crying, welding, and painting. It's indisputable that each Teutul is a gifted mechanic, engineer and designer, they put together a motorbike in front of the viewers and make every customer's wish come true.

programme.title: Kindig Customs: Road To The Ridler
programme.desc: The pinnacle of the custom car world is the Don Ridler Award, given out every year at the Detroit Autorama. Dave Kindig has always had a Ridler-sized itch he needed to scratch, and has finally found the right client and idea to make it a reality.

programme.title: Mike Brewer: Born Dealer
programme.desc: Mike buys a stinker of a car at auction. Plus, a BMW M3 turns into a rotten headache and Mike tries to sell The Stig a nice little runaround.

programme.title: Street Outlaws
programme.desc: Reality series focuses on the amazing opportunity to dive into American street racing world. Look at how need for speed unites people and find out what adrenaline addicts are ready for in Oklahoma, unofficial capital of illegal street racing. Only top racers participate in the competition, they want to appear and stay at the A-list, everything they have to do is to try to squeeze as much performance out of their vehicles as possible.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: Drew Pritchard is a modern-day treasure hunter searching the back roads of the UK to discover hidden riches. With demanding customers, high turnover and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his crack team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life. Follow Drew and his crack team of specialists on a fascinating journey through the entire picking process – from the initial expedition, to renewal, and finally to resale. Showcasing his hard-earned knowledge and appreciation of salvage and restoration, each episode accompanies Drew on one big buying venture, such as setting off with an empty van and returning with a 20th century stained glass Gothic doorway from an Irish monastery – as well as the small, unpredictable adventures along the way. Simply discovering a treasure is only half the battle, as Drew must artfully convince owners to sell, and at his price. After a successful purchase, Drew and his team of experts bring the items back to Fabulously British Salvage, his tremendous 20,000 square foot showroom located in North Wales, to restore them to their original brilliance, before reselling them for profit. This is not an easy business, as any trip can feature the next great find or a bust that costs Drew and his team thousands. However, Drew's keen eye and adroit negotiating skills are second to none – his passion and drive for success make him one of the best in the business.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers
programme.desc: Buy, repair and restore and then resell a classic car in order to make profit- this is what Wheeler Dealers is about. The budget is limited, though you can see some exclusive and rare cars. Mike Brewer, a British dealer chooses the car carefully and hands it over to the mechanic, first Edd China, later Ant Anstead to be fixed and upgraded. The hosts are real masters of their trade, it seems they can bring life even to a piece of metal. It does not matter if you are a life-long car enthusiast or do not even have a driving license you will admire the results of hard work from the beginning to the end of the long uneasy restoring process.

programme.title: How It's Made
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered how things that surround us every day are produced? Find out about the whole process from the beginning to the end in a documentary television series How It's Made. The series demonstrates how various items like clothing and accessories, food, industrial products, cars, musical instruments and many more are manufactured. Who would have thought how exciting it would be to watch a cupcake, formula 1 race car or gummy vitamins being made?

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: As the modern world becomes progressively automated and mechanised it's easy to become detached from how things are made and how they work. The hit series returns to uncover the miraculous feats of engineering which underpin life in the 21st century. How the seemingly mundane are often the result of highly sophisticated engineering and production processes. This fascinating behind-the-scenes journey delves deep into the production of everyday modern items from surfboards to satchels and trombones to cricket bats.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: The Restorers
programme.desc: Expert craftsmen are bringing Drew Pritchard's finds back to life and restore them to their former glory. Drew hunts for treasures such as derelict gems and forgotten remnants across the country. And then he and his team do the restoration turning trash to gold, so that worn objects become shining gems for which Drew's customers want to pay a lot of money. All kinds of items can and will be restored, starting from a century-old suitcase to an ancient coffee machine, from a ravaged carousel horse to a large railway clock.

programme.title: The Great Antiques Challenge
programme.desc: Six antiques dealers go head-to-head to find the perfect antique, collectable or curio for a client, using their own money to buy items that will solve a particular problem at a price they are willing to pay.

programme.title: Tiny House Hunters
programme.desc: Reality series showing American house hunters who are considering joining the tiny-house revolution where people are choosing to live in smaller homes - often less than 55 square metres -and praising their benefits. In this property series realtors present three petite houses to prospective buyers. Some of the homes would be used as permanent residences whilst others could be a retreat to escape to. There are various reasons for the trend for tiny-living; some people are doing it for financial reasons, others are trying to live more ecologically and some yearn for a simpler lifestyle. When the potential tiny-homeowners are faced with the practical limitations of the properties on offer will they take the plunge and embrace the joys of tiny living? Or will they change their minds for more spacious accommodation?

programme.title: Overhaulin'
programme.desc: Overhaulin' is an American reality TV series about customizing cars. The main difference from the other shows of this type is detailed presentation of the technical process and import scene plus serious-minded approach to the car owner's needs. The hosts are Chip Foose and Chris Jacobs. The concept of the series is that the car owner is absolutely unaware of what's going on. His car disappears one day and the owner is convinced that it has been stolen, misplaced or lost at a mechanic's shop, or has been towed away by police. Chip Foose and a team of mechanics have a week to remake the car into a custom masterpiece. Each show ends up with the surprise reuniting of the owner and his customized baby on four wheels.

Struggling homesteaders across the country call these experts to help them save their homesteads and become self-sufficient while they teach them the necessary skills to survive the wilderness.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers World Tour
programme.desc: Having wanted to buy a Ford Cortina for 20 years, Mike finally finds a rust-free Mk2 in Malta. Unfortunately, the rest of the car is a complete mess.

programme.title: Kindig Customs
programme.desc: Bitchin' Rides is a reality styled TV show hosted by Dave Kindig from the Salt Lake City, Utah-based company Kindig It Designs. Dave's real passion is designing and building custom cars. We watch the process of restoring and rebuilding all types and all periods of cars. In each episode Dave and his team review a car, create a design, then the team takes it apart and rebuilds to create a one-of-a-kind gem. Things get really ugly before they get pretty. Dave has the best team of top mechanics, technicians and fabricators in the business, quality is their only focus when they create the baddest bitchin' rides.

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: How Do They Do It? Ever wondered how the stripes get into toothpaste or how contact lenses are made? How do goods get from one country to another and then into our supermarkets? What are car tires made from and exactly why are plasma TV screens flat? Eating, drinking, driving, flying. These all are activities that we carry out with barely a second thought. But have you ever wondered what exactly goes into your teabag and how it got there? How does an airport handle hundreds of thousands of items of luggage each day? And just how can a car's airbag inflate so quickly? Every day – often without even realizing it – we come into contact with technology, be it in the bathroom, in the car or on the golf course. We take a look at how things work, and focus on some of the most amazing examples of everyday objects including the world's fastest elevator and the most expensive chocolate money can buy.

programme.title: Alaska: The Last Frontier
programme.desc: American reality series is about Alaskan pioneers Yule and Ruth Kilcher and their kids living together at their homestead. The Kilchers demonstrate one-of-a-kind model of surviving in severe conditions of the last frontier. Enjoy amazing panorama views of Alaska, showing its various nature. Sitting in a comfortable chair in your warm apartment just try to imagine how it really is when electricity and running water is not inevitable fact of life. The Kilchers hunt, go fishing, garden, gather, raise livestock in order to survive Alaska's uncontrollable power and wilderness.

They purchase all kinds of old cars, bikes, jeeps, tractors and other vehicles in order to renovate them and sell after the rehabilitation work is over. The old vehicles are restored and given second life. It is a risky business and the two always wonder if they manage to make profit this time.

programme.title: Extreme Engineering

Others talked abount projects that are currently under construction like Tuneling Under the Alps. And some episodes talked about more futuristic projects that may never be done like the Transatlantic Tunnel. Most episodes finished by examining some sort of disaster scenario which could threaten or ruin the project that was being examined.

programme.title: Body Cam
programme.desc: Documentary series following police officers across the USA as they put their lives on the line to enforce the law. Using real footage from the officer's body cameras, we show just how deadly routine checks can be, with law enforcement officials having to think on their feet and make split-second decisions to potentially save their, or someone else's, life. From knife-wielding maniacs to brutal shootouts, the series highlights the importance of our police departments. With interviews from the officers involved adding context to the footage, Body Cam Cops gives viewers unprecedented, exclusive access to what life is truly like in the line of duty.

programme.desc: Taher loses his temper when Nicole reveals concerns over converting to Islam, and Jose puts his music career on hold to provide for his newborn baby.

programme.title: Polyfamily
programme.desc: The quad brings home their fifth child, Quintin! Family members attend a party to meet the new baby, but not everyone is supportive.

programme.title: Outdaughtered
programme.desc: 40 bottles a day, 420 diapers a week and feedings every three hours became the new normal for Danielle and Adam Busby when they welcomed home the only all-female set of quintuplets in the country. The family of three became a family of eight overnight, and TLC follows that incredible journey in the new series OutDaughtered. The series captures Danielle, Adam and their adorable 4-year-old daughter Blayke as they adjust to their new life, while trying to hold on to the identities and lives they had cultivated before the five new additions arrived. Following the hilarious and heartwarming antics of the entire family including Danielle's zany mother, Michelle, and her older twin sisters and their families, it's all hands on deck as the family relies on their tight-knit circle to make the most out of this incredible lifetime adventure.

programme.title: Doubling Down With the Derricos
programme.desc: Although sleepless nights, sibling squabbles and living rooms full of toe-tripping toys are a regular feature in any home with kids, what really happens when there are 14 of them under one roof? The series features a Las Vegas couple, Karen and Deon, who have had four sets of multiples back to back, with all of them being conceived naturally. The show will showcase the endearing couple who are all set to welcome a set of triplets while raising the elder 11, their ages ranging from 2 to 14. While Karen and Deon both have always wanted to have a big family, a ménage of 14 is not exactly they'd wished for. With both having inherited a gene pool that boasts a lineage of multiple births, the show will portray how the family celebrates and embraces all of life's hurdles and drama with open arms.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress
programme.desc: Delves into the heart of world famous Kleinfeld Bridal where the staff face immense pressure to help each bride find the dress if her dreams. Take a peak at the brides as they try on their dream dresses! It brings us up close and into the dressing room as brides prepare for their big day. Moms, bridesmaids and friends all express their opinions and often frustrate both bride and staff. In the end though, most brides find that "dream dress" and walk down with their grooms into wedded bliss.

programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiancé: Happily Ever After?
programme.desc: American reality series, a follow-up spinoff of ''90 Day Fiancé'' that features couples who have applied for or received a K-1 visa (available uniquely to foreign fiancés of U.S. citizens) and have ninety days to marry each other, follows some of the most famous and interesting couples from the original show and documents the ups and downs of their relationships after they got married. For some of these couples, the real drama is just starting because they barely know each other and they have to battle critics, doubters, and various obstacles on their road to love. Some of the couples that are featured on the show are Danielle and Mohamed, Melanie and Devar, Loren and Alexei, Kyle and Noon, Brett and Daya and Russ and Paola.

programme.title: Polyfamily
programme.desc: The quad brings home their fifth child, Quintin! Family members attend a party to meet the new baby, but not everyone is supportive.

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: Carlo's Bakery in Hoboken New Jersey create elaborate, elegant and interesting edible art cakes. Cake Boss follows the team, led by Buddy Valastro, as they design and create two of these masterpieces for all kinds of events and occassions. The show explores the intricacy of working with your family, and their interpersonal relationships with other employees. Watch as they create everything from classic wedding cakes to alien spaceships.

programme.title: Design Down Under

programme.title: Outdaughtered

The series captures Danielle, Adam and their adorable 4-year-old daughter Blayke as they adjust to their new life, while trying to hold on to the identities and lives they had cultivated before the five new additions arrived. Following the hilarious and heartwarming antics of the entire family including Danielle's zany mother, Michelle, and her older twin sisters and their families, it's all hands on deck as the family relies on their tight-knit circle to make the most out of this incredible lifetime adventure.

The show will showcase the endearing couple who are all set to welcome a set of triplets while raising the elder 11, their ages ranging from 2 to 14. Despite her daily challenges, Baylen and her family aren't afraid to laugh and embrace the chaos that makes their everyday lives in West Virginia unique. With Baylen yearning for independence, she'll need to rely less on her family as she takes steps toward being in the world on her own.

programme.title: One Day In My Body
programme.desc: Tiffany has progeria, a condition that causes her to age rapidly. Ryan was born with arthrogryposis, leaving his arms and legs fused.

programme.title: Worst Disease You've Never Heard Of: Body Bizarre
programme.desc: The stories of people who suffer from rare and mysterious medical conditions. Some need surgery so complex that the odds of survival are slim.

programme.title: Body Invaders
programme.desc: From fence posts and refrigerator magnets to surf boards and garden shears, 'I Was Impaled' tells incredible true tales of people from around the world who have accidentally ended up with foreign objects in their bodies. Each story is brought to life by first-person testimony and CGI reconstruction, starting from the discovery of the injury to the groundbreaking medical treatment. It describes in detail how the dangerous, bizarre object entered the body, how it affected organs and influenced behaviour, and why the matter was often inches away from causing death.

programme.title: My Feet Are Killing Me
programme.desc: Quarantining at home hasn't stopped everyone's favorite foot fixers from helping patients with their foot troubles. Dr. Brad and Dr. Ebonie are teaming up with the compassionate and intelligent Dr. Sarah Haller, who is joining the medical series and has been working alongside Dr. Brad for years, on all new episodes of MY FEET ARE KILLING ME: FIRST STEPS. In the midst of a world shutdown by COVID-19, these dynamic foot doctors pledge to help shocking podiatric cases, one video call at a time. Each 30-minute episode will follow three patients as they undergo virtual consultations to begin their journey towards surgeries that will leave their feet radically transformed and their lives changed forever. COVID toes have nothing on these cases!

programme.desc: A quiet day turns tense as drug traffickers lead the Coastguard's boats and helicopters on a high-speed chase as they try to reach Moroccan waters, where the Spanish teams have no jurisdiction. An illegal fishing boat has entered a protected nature reserve and must be stopped. And a distress call comes in for a dinghy drifting in dangerous waters with 14 people onboard.

programme.title: Toronto Airport Uncovered
programme.desc: At Toronto International Airport, multiple challenges push staff to their limits. An oversold flight needs passengers to surrender their seats, but will any volunteer? Cracked windows risk grounding a Dreamliner - they're still airworthy, but would anyone feel safe sitting beside them? And a rookie firefighter faces her biggest challenge, driving a state-of-the-art fire truck on a live airfield.

programme.title: Toronto Airport Uncovered
programme.desc: An Airside Electrical team investigates faulty airfield lights and finds that rodents, taking refuge from the brutal Canadian winter, have damaged the cabling. On the ramp, high winds make loading cargo difficult, and mean jets can't start their engines without help from one of the unsung heroes of the airport. And in security screening a scan reveals possible explosives in a passenger's baggage. Final

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: In Hardanger, two smuglers have driven into a snowbank in the mountains, but it's hard for towing veteran Bjørn Lægreid to believe what's inside the vehicle. At the same time a Türkish driver is stuck in Odda for weeks on end, with summer tires and no driver's license. Tow truck boss Thord Paulsen tries to help with new tires, but there's problems with the payment. In Finnsnes, Northern Norway, Frank Sebulonsen and his apprentice go out to rescue a truck blocking the road, but as he pulls the wires around a tree, they put their lives at risk as things don't go as planned.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: After a period of warm temperatures and few rescues, tow truck boss Thord heaves a sigh of relief when it starts snowing. In the snowstorm, a 20-ton transporter slides off the road, and a car falls into a deep ditch. Thord decides to rescue them both. He needs all the work he can get to keep his business going. On Bjorn's territory, a foreign driver is stuck on a mountain pass. He has failed to put tyre chains on, which makes Bjorn grumpy.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Scrapyard Supercar
programme.desc: Petrolhead Shane Lynch is setting two teams of amateur mechanics a task of epic proportions; they have just four days to build monster machines that can out-perform a "top-trump" attribute of a supercar! Under the expert guidance of head-engineer Ralph Hosier, theyve got free reign in an automotive scrapyard to build their vehicles, before going head-to-head on the racetrack to see which performs best. Through the teams trials and tribulations, we will learn how supercars work, and learn just how hard it is to achieve perfection. From acceleration to braking, handling to grip, this is a true test of beauty vs beast. Scrapyard Supercar.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: This is a show about your brain and trust. Does it sometimes seem like you have to be on your guard all the time against untrustworthy advertisers, politicians, and other people? So how do you maintain a level of trust in an untrustworthy world - and what is trust anyway? Through a series of fun and interactive games, you'll learn to trust others a little more and your own brain a little less! Prepare to put your trust in Brain Games.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: National Geographic Channel's Emmy-nominated series Brain Games returns this summer with 10 new mind-blowing episodes! Host Jason Silva gets inside your head and shows you what's really going on in there with an intricate series of interactive experiments designed to mess with your mind and reveal the inner-workings of your brain. Hailed by critics as "tremendous fun" that "makes science entertaining," Brain Games turns your mind's eye inwards for a fascinating journey into the three and a half pounds of tissue that makes you... you.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Whether its remembering where you parked the car, or just finding the light switch in the morning, navigating your busy world can be tough. Luckily your brain has a built-in navigation system to help make sense of your surroundings. In fact, recent discoveries prove that the brain uses place cells and direction cells to help get us to where were going. In this episode we explore spatial awareness. Its how your brain tells you where you are. Through a series of games and experiments well test the boundaries of your brains hardwired sense of direction, and prove how you arent always aware of your surroundings or even your body. Plus youll learn a surprising technique to enhance your spatial memory.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Seconds from Disaster
programme.desc: Waco, Texas. On February 28th 1993 the Bureau of Alcohol Tobacco and Firearms raid a compound belonging to a religious cult called the Branch Davidians. They attempt to arrest cult leader David Koresh for alleged firearms offences. A gunfight breaks out that leaves six Branch Davidians and four ATF agents dead. The FBI arrives to take control but the situation escalates into one of the Americas longest sieges. After a fifty-one day stand off the FBI launches a dawn assault. Using military tanks they inject tear gas through the walls and windows in an attempt to force the Branch Davidians out. Besieged cult members refuse to surrender and a disastrous fire engulfs their compound in less than twenty minutes. Nearly 80 people including twenty-eight children were killed during the fire. [add] Seconds from Disaster counts down to the moment fire breaks out and investigates whether the Branch Davidians were led to their deaths by charismatic cult leader David Koresh or killed by murderous Federal agents.

programme.title: Seconds from Disaster
programme.desc: In March 2011, as Japan reels from the most powerful earthquake in its history, a 14 metre-high tsunami surges over the Fukushima Dai-ichi nuclear power plant, knocking out its power supply and essential cooling systems. With the plant blacked out, engineers face nuclear meltdown. The reactors begin to overheat leading to two huge explosions that tear the plant apart and dispersing radiation. As Japan faces the worst nuclear emergency since Chernobyl, an international nuclear expert will investigate exactly what happed at Fukushima and see what, if anything, could have been done to prevent it.

programme.title: Ancient Structures: Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: Throughout history, the colossal monuments of our ancestors have embodied their determination to leave a lasting mark on the world. The Colosseum — a spectacular feat of engineering and design that once hosted violent spectacles for thousands — holds the secrets of Roman ingenuity. The serpentine expanse of the Great Wall of China, winding over 21,000 kilometers, conceals clues of its construction and surprising ingredients that not only fortify its strength but also reflect the resourcefulness of the builders charged with protecting an empire. Malbork Castle, the largest brick fortress in the world, showcases the military prowess of the Teutonic Knights. Its strategic design and defensive features hold untold stories of battles fought and won.

programme.title: Ancient Structures: Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: Humanity's relentless drive to innovate has left an indelible mark on our planet's most volatile landscapes. Atop the sheer volcanic plug known as Sigiriya, a Sri Lankan king builds an impregnable fortress, complete with innovative hydraulics and stunning frescoes. On Easter Island, the resilient Rapa Nui people carve and transport colossal moai statues, their cultural practices enduring beyond European contact. And in India, the Kailasa Temple in the Ellora Caves stands as an architectural marvel. Inspired by the legend of a queen's vow, the miraculous structure is carved top-down from solid basaltic rock.

programme.title: Airport Security: To Catch a Smuggler Latin America Compilation
programme.desc: Parents with kids are arrested for drug-trafficking. From Airport Security Colombia and Peru, cocaine busts that include families. A mother with kids going to Barcelona carries cocaine in food packages. A man with kids at home confesses. A mother leaving the country with kids uses fake documents. A woman with her infant son enters the country with help from officials. A couple are not what they seem. The woman did it to help her daughter.

programme.title: Airport Security: To Catch a Smuggler Latin America Compilation
programme.desc: Carriers are often defiant towards officials, but crumble in the end. Cases of protest and denial from Airport Security Colombia and Peru. Sisters deny ingesting drugs but break down when one reveals she is pregnant. A drunk man denies the checked bag is his but is arrested and confesses. A young woman claims she is innocent but may have a mental illness. A young man with liquid cocaine in beer lies at first, but then breaks down.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: The Christmas holidays begin under extreme conditions as the heaviest snowstorm in 5 years slams into the region, bringing transport to a near standstill. At Central Station, the Christmas spirit descends as thousands of additional holiday passengers are expected despite the weather, turning an already busy period into a logistical battle. Inside the control room, Code Orange is declared as delays cascade across the network. A stalled train compounds the disruption, while platforms grow crowded. Assistant station manager Michel coordinates Christmas decorations while Ticket & Service staff Alexandra and Gusta help create a festive atmosphere. Meanwhile, Safety & Service officers Menno and Baran respond to one incident after another. With snow piling up and pressure mounting, everybody must work together to prevent total gridlock.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: Ancient Structures: Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: The Inca fortress of Sacsayhuamán stands high above Cusco as a colossal mystery of construction. Its gargantuan stones, so precisely fitted, seem to defy rational explanation and have given rise to tales of demonic assistance. Deep in Rajasthan, India, the Chand Baori stepwell plunges 13 stories into the earth, its 3,500 perfectly arranged steps forming a hypnotic geometry so meticulous that locals whisper of unholy pacts. And in the heart of Paris, the Notre-Dame Cathedral soars skyward, its Gothic spires and intricate ironwork pushed medieval engineering to such extremes that stories circulated of dark bargains. Did the creators of these structures truly strike a "deal with the devil," or do these wonders simply reflect the often-misunderstood genius of our ancestors?

programme.title: Ancient Structures: Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: Commissioned by Emperor Shah Jahan as a mausoleum for his beloved wife, the Taj Mahal stands as a crown jewel of Mughal architecture and an embodiment of eternal devotion. Beneath Germany's 11th century Speyer Cathedral, Salian emperors built a cavernous crypt, revealing astounding visions of the afterlife and their desire to secure a place in eternity. Carved high into the cliffs of Turkey, the intricate Lycian tombs offer a window into a mysterious ancient civilization's vibrant beliefs about the afterlife. Each monumental structure holds valuable clues to unravel the mysteries of how ancient ancestors approached the inevitability of death. More than mere burial sites, they reveal complex philosophies about life and what lies beyond.

programme.title: Airport Security: Peru
programme.desc: Security teams at Lima, Peru's airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. The biggest threat: cocaine smuggling. Handmade mats include additional handiwork: 100's of bags of cocaine. A student on vacation is carrying more than keepsakes: a hidden compartment hides cocaine. A Latvian carrier wants to cooperate. Cocaine hidden inside a wooden sculpture of Jesus Christ. Police listen in as a carrier takes a call from his contact.

programme.title: Airport Security: Peru
programme.desc: Security teams at Lima, Peru's airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. The biggest threat: cocaine smuggling. Two Ukrainian passengers are caught with cocaine. And one may have tricked the other. Police will need a translator to sort it out. A couple celebrating their anniversary may be taking home more than just memories. Customs find more than 130,000 euros hidden in the carry-on of an arriving passenger and move in to investigate.

programme.title: Airport Security: Peru
programme.desc: Security teams at Lima, Peru's airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. The biggest threat: cocaine smuggling. A couple is caught carrying cocaine in bottled beverages. And the girlfriend may have been in the dark about the entire scheme. Cocaine is uncovered, disguised as packaged food. And this may not be the carrier's first job. Police discover cocaine sewn into panels of an insulated jacket and that could be just the beginning.

programme.title: Airport Security: Peru
programme.desc: Security teams at Lima, Peru's airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. The biggest threat: cocaine smuggling. X-Ray scans show unusual shapes in a woman's platform shoes - and something shocking inside her body. A suspect says he has information to take down drug trafficking organizations. A suspect on a stopover may be carrying cocaine hidden in drink bottles. Energy pills destined for England may contain something else: high purity cocaine.

programme.title: Airport Security: Colombia
programme.desc: Antinarcotics police officers at El Dorado International Airport, in Bogota, Colombia, fight the most daring and unexpected attempts to smuggle drugs out of the country. Behind the apparent innocence of a young woman traveling with her stepmother, the officers stop one of the biggest drug smuggling attempts in years. Later, they won't believe their eyes when the X-ray machine reveals that a young man is wearing a cocaine-filled adult diaper. Immigration officers must contend with an out of control Cuban passenger to whom they are forced to deport. Later, tragedy unfolds when they must prevent a mother from traveling with her young daughter to Europe. A thrifty passenger manages to pass through all airport security check-points with two kilograms of cocaine hidden in his carry-on bag, but he will be cornered as the officers' well-trained sense of smell will trigger and make him a suspect. A passenger on her way to the Dominican Republic denies being the owner of a bag as it's about to be searched. The inspection will reveal something unexpected.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: Border Protection Spain
programme.desc: During the night, a call from a distressed mother alerts the Coastguard to a potential suicide attempt in a treacherous area. Aided by helicopters, a team intercepts drug traffickers carrying over 3 tons of hashish. Fishermen using illegal devices try to fish in protected waters and a German sailboat raises suspicion.

programme.title: Suvereporter
programme.desc: Suvine uudistemagasin liigub sinna, kus Eesti suvi parajasti kõige elavamalt keeb. Saade toob vaatajani päeva olulisemad sündmused, värvikad inimesed ja meeleolukad lood rannast, linnamelust, festivalidelt, külapidudelt, aga ka Meediamaja rõdult. Reporterile omases hoogsas võtmes jõuavad ekraanile värsked uudised, elulised reportaažid, ootamatud kohtumised ja hetked, mis teevad Eesti suve eriliseks. Saatejuhid Jaanus Koort, Simon Suviste ja Tõnis Sarap hoiavad silma peal nii tõsisematel teemadel kui ka suvistel seikadel meil ja mujal maailmas.

programme.title: Vaikse ookeani võitlus
programme.desc: Seiklusmärul kahest piloodist, kellest saab tulnukate rünnaku alla langenud inimkonna viimane lootus. Ehkki tulnukaid on alati oodatud avakosmosest, ründavad nad tegelikult hoopis meresügavustest. Algab meeleheitlik lahing ja et ülekaalukat vaenlast hävitada, võtavad inimesed kasutusele kõrgtehnoloogilised hiigelrobotid. Nende juhtimiseks on aga vaja erakordsete võimetega piloote...

programme.title: Liikleja
programme.desc: Mis on Eesti liikluses valesti? Mille üle saab uhke olla? Milliste reeglite vastu kõige enam eksitakse? Saatesari "Liikleja" võtab kord kuus luubi alla ühe liiklusohutusalase teema. "Liikleja" näitab, mis toimub Eesti liikluses, annab nõu ja jagab näpunäiteid, mis on elupäästvad ning muudavad liikluse Eestis ohutumaks. Tänapäeva ühiskonda on tabanud uus hullus ja selleks on nutisõltuvus! Mõni inimene ei suuda minutitki olla nii, et ta ei vaataks oma telefoni! Kahjuks on see nii ka liikluses! Seekord uuritakse \"Liikleja\" saates, kui ohtlikud on liigeldes kõrvalised tegevused ja kuidas teha nii, et need tähelepanu ei rööviks ning inimesi ohtu ei seaks! Saates saavad sõna PPA ja Transpordiameti eksperdid. Tähelepanu-testis paneb end proovile lauljatar Grete Paia. Saatejuht on Jaanus Koort.

The Fifth Quarter
programme.desc: Each episode covers key moments from the games, statistics, strategies, as well as interviews with players and coaches. It's a show for true basketball fans who want to stay up to date with the latest trends and news from the world of sports.

programme.title: Tennis: Wimbledon. Highlights Day 10
programme.desc: Wimbledon is more than just a tennis tournament — it's a summer tradition, a slice of British culture, and one of the most iconic sporting events in the world. Held every year in London, England, usually in late June to early July, it's where the best tennis players on the planet come to battle it out on the famous grass courts of the All England Club. It's actually the oldest tennis tournament in the world, dating back to 1877, and it's still the only Grand Slam played on grass — the fastest and most unpredictable surface. That's part of what makes it so exciting. Matches are intense, fast-paced, and full of surprises. Wimbledon is packed with unique traditions that make it stand out. Players are required to wear all white on court — no exceptions. The crowd enjoys strawberries and cream, and you won't see flashy ads around the court — it's all about the game. And of course, there's the Royal Box, where you might spot celebrities or even members of the British Royal Family watching the action. From rising stars to tennis legends, everyone dreams of lifting the famous Wimbledon trophy. There's something magical about seeing players walk onto Centre Court, hearing the roar of the crowd, and witnessing moments that go down in sports history. Whether you're a tennis fan or just love great sports drama, Wimbledon is a must-watch — classy, thrilling, and full of unforgettable moments.

programme.desc: Seriaali keskmes on Tallinnas elav perekond - noor naine, tema keskealine mees ja nende väike poeg. Sarja intriigide käivitajaks on mehe eelmine perekond. Põnevust lisavad ka naabrid, sugulased ja tuttavad. Tegevus toimub tänapäeva Eestis ning sarjas, nii nagu ka päris elus, on armastust ja vihkamist, pettumust, leppimist, armukadedust ning huumorit. Sarja peaosatäitjateks on näitlejad Eesti erinevatest teatritest. Martin Veinmann kehastab sarjas pereisa Hannest, tema noort naist Helenit mängib Kleer Maibaum, perepea esimest naist Epp Eespäev ning pereisa tütart esimesest abielust kehastab Kadri Adamson

programme.desc: TV3 uudistetoimetus võtab igal õhtul operatiivselt ja asjatundlikult kokku olulisemad päevasündmused nii Eestist kui ka mujalt maailmast. Kui igatsed uudistesaadet, mis on aktuaalne, täpne, pisut terav, südamlik ning kus saab ka grammikese nalja, siis õige valik on "TV3 uudised". "TV3 uudised" on eetris igal õhtul kell 19.00. Argipäeviti mahub tunniajasesse saatesse põhjalik ülevaade nii Eestist kui välismaalt. Räägime näiliselt keerulistest asjadest selgelt ja arusaadavalt - sest aega on. Uudistesaate juhid on Liina Kanarbik, Marek Lindmaa ja Tarmo Maiberg. Reportaaže otse sündmuskohtadelt toovad teieni Sirje Eesmaa, Allan Muuk, Sven Soiver, Virgo Pärn, Kadri Pikhof, Marie Metsur, Christina Veinberg ja Tiina Laura Kimmel.

Kartmatud saatejuhid Indrek Vaheoja ja Kristjan Rabi proovivad erinevaid ameteid, võtavad vastu külalisi ja jagavad ellujäämise saladusi neljal õhtul nädalas. Lisaks saab Eestimaa kirjust suvest osa vaatajate koduvideote kaudu.

programme.title: Malaisia
programme.desc: Romantiline seiklussari "Malaisia" valib parima armastajapaari, kes oleks väärt võitma kahenädalast luksuslikku puhkust 10000 km kaugusel kodust- eksootilises Malaisias. Kes olid need armunud noored, kes kandideerisid sellesse saatesse? Millega tehti end nähtavaks? Kas jäädi sündsuse piiridesse? Ja mis kõige tähtsam - kes siis on need armastajapaarid, kes said võimaluse osaleda uues eksootilises seikluses nimega "Malaisia"? See kõik selgub sarja esimeses saates, mida juhib Piret Järvis.

programme.title: TV3 uudised
programme.desc: TV3 uudistetoimetus võtab igal õhtul operatiivselt ja asjatundlikult kokku olulisemad päevasündmused nii Eestist kui ka mujalt maailmast. Kui igatsed uudistesaadet, mis on aktuaalne, täpne, pisut terav, südamlik ning kus saab ka grammikese nalja, siis õige valik on "TV3 uudised". "TV3 uudised" on eetris igal õhtul kell 19.00. Argipäeviti mahub tunniajasesse saatesse põhjalik ülevaade nii Eestist kui välismaalt. Räägime näiliselt keerulistest asjadest selgelt ja arusaadavalt - sest aega on. Uudistesaate juhid on Liina Kanarbik, Marek Lindmaa ja Tarmo Maiberg. Reportaaže otse sündmuskohtadelt toovad teieni Sirje Eesmaa, Allan Muuk, Sven Soiver, Virgo Pärn, Kadri Pikhof, Marie Metsur, Christina Veinberg ja Tiina Laura Kimmel.

programme.title: Kiired ja vihased
programme.desc: USA-Saksamaa 2001 märul Lavastaja: Rob Cohen Osades: Vin Diesel, Paul Walker, Jordana Brewster, Michelle Rodriguez Dominic Toretto (Vin Diesel) sõidab L.A. tänavatel nagu kuuluks need talle. Päevad veedab ta oma töökojas, remontides teiste autosid, öösiti on ta aga tänavate kuningas, kes teenib kuni 10 000 dollarit võidusõidu pealt. Seda muidugi juhul, kui leidub keegi, kes julgeb talle väljakutse esitada. Brian (Paul Walker) on just selline, pealtnäha hulljulge seikleja, kes tahaks pääseda Dominici ohtlikku maailma, mida ajavad edasi adrenaliin, seksuaalne pinge ja toores, kontrollimatu kiirus. Seejuures peab Brian olema äärmiselt ettevaatlik, et ettearvamatu Dominic ega seksikas Mia (Jordana Brewster) ei saaks teada tema sealviibimise tegelikku põhjust…

programme.title: Perepea
programme.desc: "Perepea" on Ameerika Ühendriikide animeeritud situatsioonikomöödia, mille autor on Seth MacFarlane. Sari räägib perekond Griffinitest, kes elavad väljamõeldud Quahogi-nimelises linnas, mis asub Rhode Islandil.

programme.title: Suure paugu teooria

programme.title: Kutsuge Cobra 11
programme.desc: Sõjalennuk teeb tehnilise rikke tõttu hädamaandumise. Esialgu jääb süüdlaseks noor piloot, sest arvatakse, et tal pole piisavalt kogemusi. Semir ja Ben avastavad, et lennuväebaasis tegeleb keegi ebaseadusliku varuosadeäriga. Kasumliku äri jätkamiseks on ta valmis üle laipade minema.

programme.title: Walker, Texase korravalvur

programme.title: Kutsuge Cobra 11
programme.desc: Saksamaa kiirteed on muutunud ühenduslüliks ida ja lääne vahel, kus liiguvad kõiksugu sorti hämarad tegelased ja eluohtlikud laadungid. Kiirteel töötavad politseinikud, kes ohtliku töö tegemisel kohtuvad päevast päeva lapseröövlite, salakaubitsejate, põgenike ja mõrtsukatega.

programme.title: Simpsonid
programme.desc: Lisa sõbruneb uur tüdruku Harperiga, kes on juhtumisi ropprikas. Siis sõbruneb Homer Harperi isaga ja saab kogeda rikka sõbra eeliseid. Kuid Lisa otsustab, et Harper on kiusaja ja tahab sõprusele lõpu teha. Homer üritab olukorda parandada, et ei peaks luksuslikust elust loobuma.

programme.title: Perepea
programme.desc: Briani käsikiri lükatakse mitmendat korda tagasi ja ta otsustab alla anda, aga proovib siis Stewie õhutusel veel üks kord. Lois otsustab, et tema ja Peter peaksid magama eraldi voodites. Selle tõttu hakkab Peter otsima kedagi, kelle kaisus magada.

programme.title: Suure paugu teooria
programme.desc: Doktor Pemberton ja doktor Campbell, füüsikud Chicagost, tõestavad Sheldoni ja Amy superasümmeetria teooria ära. Noorpaar on üliõnnelik, aga Amy proovitakse Nobelile kandideerijate hulgast välja puksida. Bernadette on tööl väga edukas ning Pennyl on selles oma osa, tahab ta seda või ei.

programme.title: Suure paugu teooria
programme.desc: Sheldon on vaimustuses, kui saab aidata Bernadette'il ja Wolowitzil bürokraatiaga toime tulla, aga avastab siis, et nad rikuvad seadust. Leonard on pettunud, kui ta sõbrad jätavad ta teadusprojektist kõrvale.

programme.title: Inisherini hinged
programme.desc: Iirimaa lääneranniku lähedal asuval saarel elavad eluaegsed sõbrad Padraic ja Colm, kes satuvad ummikusse, kui Colm nende sõprusele ootamatult lõpu teeb. Padraic, keda abistavad tema õde Siobhan ja probleemne noor saarlane Dominic, püüab suhet parandada, keeldudes sõbrast loobumast. Kuid Padraici korduvad pingutused ainult tugevdavad tema endise sõbra otsusekindlust ja kui Colm esitab meeleheitliku ultimaatumi, eskaleeruvad sündmused kiiresti, millel on šokeerivad tagajärjed.

programme.desc: Seriaali keskmes on Tallinnas elav perekond - noor naine, tema keskealine mees ja nende väike poeg. Sarja intriigide käivitajaks on mehe eelmine perekond. Põnevust lisavad ka naabrid, sugulased ja tuttavad. Tegevus toimub tänapäeva Eestis ning sarjas, nii nagu ka päris elus, on armastust ja vihkamist, pettumust, leppimist, armukadedust ning huumorit. Sarja peaosatäitjateks on näitlejad Eesti erinevatest teatritest. Martin Veinmann kehastab sarjas pereisa Hannest, tema noort naist Helenit mängib Kleer Maibaum, perepea esimest naist Epp Eespäev ning pereisa tütart esimesest abielust kehastab Kadri Adamson

programme.title: Austraalia kullakütid

programme.desc: Kultuslik merejää paneb sadamad seisma, kuid kangelased pingutavad, et kõigil oleks turvaline ja saar püsiks töös.

programme.desc: Poseidoni meeskonda vaevavad Victorias õnnetused ja nende tagajärjed ning uus meeskond Heli Hunters seisab silmitsi helikopteritega lendamise ohtudega.

programme.title: Austraalia kullakütid
programme.desc: Poseidon Crew on leidnud vana aardekaardi, mis juhatab hooaja suurima kullatüki juurde. Marcus ja Linden kutsuvad juhendaja appi, et hooaja esimesel nädalal kulla juurde jõuda.

programme.title: Kalliskivikütid Austraalias
programme.desc: Ole valmis metsikuks sõiduks safiiride jahtijatele Queenslandis, kus käib pime jaht nendele kalliskividele

programme.desc: Load on nii kauaks venima jäänud, et Poseidoni tiim hakkab ellujäämiseks metsikut kulda otsima. Gold Gypsies leiab aga hea saagi ja Dust Devilsi risk lõpeb mehaanilise äpardusega.

programme.title: Austraalia kullakütid
programme.desc: Shane ja Russell püüavad oma hooaja päästa. Victoria Diggers on sunnitud naabri maa peal kaevama. Vennad Marcus ja Linden jäävad kõrbesse hätta.

programme.title: Võimatud raudteed
programme.desc: Heidame pilgu maailma suurlinnade kõige võrratumatele raudteedele, alates Wuppertali tagurpidi monorelssteest Saksamaal, kuni Londoni pöördelise Crossraili projekti ning New Yorgi kaubaveosüsteemini.

programme.title: Tohutud tehnikavead
programme.desc: Sarjas paljastatakse eepilisi läbikukkumisi ja napikaid, ebaharilikest kuni naeruväärseteni välja, millest insenerid parema meelega ei räägiks. Analüüsime, mis võis valesti minna ja paljastame probleemide lahendusi.

programme.title: Pahatahtlik ehitus
programme.desc: Alates Junior Johnsoni kuupaistelisest tõusust NASCARis kuni keerukate salakaubaveotunneliteni - see episood käsitleb, kuidas on kuritegelik leidlikkus ebaseaduslikke tööstusi kujundanud.

programme.title: Autsaideritest rekkajuhid
programme.desc: Jälgime väikest, aga võimekat Dale Kristenseni, kes on rekkajuht ja meistrimees. Kui Dale üritab pojale luua paremat tulevikku, seisab ta silmitsi seljaoperatsiooniga, mis võib ta plaanid purustada.

programme.title: Jäätunud kuld
programme.desc: Ray ja Elley lähevad kontimurdvale retkele naaberkaevandusse. Kui Erik Kimberley ja Tiffany hakkavad pärast luhtunud lüüsi ülesseadmise katset mässama, kritiseerib Erik Ray juhtimist.

programme.title: East Harbouri kangelased

programme.title: Toidu ABC
programme.desc: Purustame toiduainete kohta keerlevaid müüte ja laseme teaduslikel argumentidel kõnelda.

programme.title: Pilvede all
programme.desc: Õed on jõuluõhtuks Mari juurde kogunenud, kuid kutsututest on nii mõnedki pereliikmed puudu. Kuid jõulud on teatavasti imede aeg... Albert ja Inna veedavad pühad Sirje ja Gunnariga. Uus aasta algab kõiki rõõmustava sündmusega!

programme.title: Esmakohtingud. Austraalia
programme.desc: Jamesi ja Marsha kohmakad katsed lõõpida nende vahel keemiat ei loo. Nad poolitavad arve ja lähevad kumbki oma teed. Austine lämmatab oma jutukusega Ashleigh'd, kes lihtsalt lahkub. Richardi ja Jonathani ühendavad Brad Pitt, suudlus ja soov ka teisele kohtingule minna. Shadi ja Marina sarnased usuvaated ja tätoveeringud sillutavad nende tee õnnele.

programme.title: Armastuse hind
programme.desc: Ferit ja Seyran on õnne tipul, kui Ferit Seyranile romantilise üllatuse teeb. Ece röövitakse. Piril saabub ootamatult Pelini poole, kus ta näeb ka Kaya, ent ta ei oska veel midagi kahtlustada. Suna näeb Abidini koos Ayseniga ning tekitab skandaali. Nurka surutuna ütleb Abidin kättemaksuks, et kavatseb Ayseniga abielluda.

programme.title: Kodus ja võõrsil
programme.desc: Fenomenaalselt edukas ja pikaealine Austraalia draamasari ookeani-äärse väikelinna Summer Bay elanike rõõmudest ja muredest, armumistest ja südamete purunemistest. Sarja trumbiks on haaravad ja inimlikult usutavad tegelaskujud, kelle eludega on vaatajal kerge samastuda. Tegelaste galerii on ka piisavalt mitmekesine, et igaüks leiaks endale lemmiku, kellele kaasa elada - siin on nii teismelisi, noori täiskasvanuid kui ka juba küpsesse keskikka jõudnud peategelasi. Lisaboonuseks on Summer Bay igikestev päikesepaiste, mis rõhutab sarja positiivsust ja elurõõmu.

programme.title: Briti parim pagar
programme.desc: Pagarid valmistavad creme caramel'i, klassikalist siirupiga keeksi ja lummavat beseepommi. Kes tõuseb tippu ja kelle jalgealune lööb vankuma?

programme.title: Utta Danella - Praha saladus
programme.desc: Edukas juveliir Claudius tähistab abikaasa Christine'iga kuldpulmi. Peole ilmub ootamatult noor naine Prahast, Claudiuse väljaspool abielu sündinud tütar Anica, kelle olemasolu on mees seni maha vaikinud. Kohtumine on kõigile nii piinlik, et Anica lahkub. Christine turvaline maailm variseb kokku ja ta peab otsustama, kuidas edasi elada. Claudius sõidab Prahasse, et tütrega asjad selgeks rääkida.

programme.title: Igavene Valentin
programme.desc: Kui õnnetu baarikaklus pöörab Wyomingu puhkekeskuse ühiskondliku töö tandriks, avastavad suurlinnatüdrukud Julia ja Sydney ootamatu missiooni, mis muudab nende mõlema elu igaveseks.

programme.title: Luksuskinnisvarahaid
programme.desc: D'Leanne korraldab avatud uste päeva vapustavas kodus mainekas Sydney eeslinnas. Gavin kasutab võimalust teha koostööd uue ostja agendiga. Monika saab teada kliendi otsuse nende põneva pakkumise kohta.
