programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: "Finding Nemo" may have brought fame to the striped clownfish but their newfound popularity has sent worldwide numbers into decline. Now we follow the aquarium team as they initiate their very own breeding program with the hope of finding many more Nemos to come. Jorge has got a 200-pound problem on his hands. Lin Mao the white tiger has something wrong with his hip and the vets need to make a diagnosis. Problem is, Lin Mao's not responding to the anesthetic Jorge just administered and he has to decide what to do next...very quickly.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Dali the emperor tamarin has an age-old problem. He's going bald. But not on his head - on his back! The Loro Parque keepers have a mystery on their hands but all evidence points to two other mischievous monkeys that are so cute - you'd never suspect a thing! Every day Loro Parque keeps a close watch on each and every animal in their care. Today though, keeper Kristina is getting a little closer than usual. She has to perform an ultrasound on Ulysses the dolphin's eye - but can she train Ulysses to keep her eye open long enough to perform the vital test? Time (and patience) will tell. It's not every day one of the cutest chimps in the zoo has a first birthday. And it's not every day Garoe, the one-year old chimp wakes up to a tasty cake hanging in his enclosure. So, what do you get when you combine cakes and chimps - a swinging good time to start!

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The charming kangaroo. The cuddly koala. The beautiful Butterfly. The cheerful clown fish. Or the endearing budgerigar – which is the cutest of them all? CLOWN FISH The warm tropical waters of the world's oceans are home to a dazzling array of beautiful marine life. KANGAROO Across Australia thousands upon thousands of kangaroos bound over the countryside. Their super powered legs are born to hop. MONACH BUTTERFLY The stunning Monarch butterflies that fill the skies are some of the most beautiful and delicate of all of the world's insects. BUDGERIGAR Wild budgerigars or "Budgies" are social nomadic little parrots that come together in their hundreds to fly in lively undulating flocks. KOALA he adorable soft-furred cuddly koala is one of the world's most well loved little creatures and one of Australia's favorite residents.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Radar accurate eyes survey the land, slotted feathers adjust flight paths as falcons attack, pelicans soar, kestrels hover, owls silently fly, parrots flock, vultures swarm and eagles swoop. Which is the true Master of the Sky? PEREGRINE FALCON Master of all they survey, the dynamic raptors are magnificent birds of prey. Revered for over 2000 years as a symbol of speed and power the peregrine falcon was a favorite with Egyptian and Chinese falconers. BUDGIE When these petite brightly colored budgies take to the air above the arid lands of Australia they color the skies green and yellow. WEDGE TAILED EAGLE Some animals inspire awe and respect by their presence alone. The wedge tailed eagle, the largest bird of prey in Australia, is one such animal. PELICAN These graceful formation flying birds that soar on thermals high above ground are some of the largest and most engaging of all the water birds. SEABIRDS Of the eight and a half thousand species of birds in the world, just under 300 of them are seabirds. Ranging from those that are migratory and dispersive to those that are rarely seen away from their breeding colonies the long-winged birds that live a life of sea and air are truly free. BARN OWL Guardian of the forest, keeper of wisdom and soul behind all seeing eyes, Barn Owls evoke an eerie respect from all who encounter them. VULTURE Constantly scanning the open plains of Africa are the highly tuned eyes of the famous birds that clean up these savannas. NANKEEN KESTREL Over the open landscapes of Australia flies its smallest falcon - the long tailed, long winged, inquisitive Nankeen Kestrel.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Predator versus prey: in this instalment we analyze three attack-escape scenarios involving bird predators and their prey. One is the climbing flight escape, another is horizontal speeding, and thirdly, there is turning and diving to avoid capture. Predator and prey attack-escape behaviour is another outcome of the evolutionary arms race. There is something about birds of prey that make us pay attention - maybe it is the inherent fear we all have that one will attack us - or perhaps it is just because they are seldom seen by most westerners. Regardless, birds of prey are fascinating and in this episode we examine of some of the largest, mightiest and most spectacular raptors from around the world. We'll watch with fascination the Eagle, a large bird of prey that is a skilled hunter and highly efficient killer. These elegant predators do their best work in large open spaces, where they can fly high and see for miles and miles. Meanwhile, the fastest living animal on land, sea or sky is also a bird of prey. The peregrine falcon can be found from the arctic to the tropics, and for centuries has been a symbol of prestige. At the other end of the scale is a bird that strips a carcass to down to its skeleton in search of a meal. The presence of a vulture is often seen as a sign of impending doom. But it's a case of whatever gets you through: the vulture too, is just trying to stay one step ahead, in the race of life.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Crocodiles , like all living reptiles, they are descended from animals that roamed the Earth about 250 million years ago. There's something so viscerally terrifying about these creatures that lay in wait for their prey, just under the waterline. The comparatively friendly seeming turtle is among the most ancient of the reptiles alive today and have a protective shell that encloses their body and provides protection and camouflage, just as it did millions of years back. They inhabit terrestrial, freshwater, and marine habitats and are found both in tropical and temperate regions. Poisonous or harmless, large or small, all snakes - from the desert rattlesnake to the dwarf pipe snake - have certain things in common: a long, thin shape; scaly, legless bodies; and unblinking, lidless eyes. Like all reptiles, snakes rely on the heat of the sun to control their body temperature. The venom of the king cobra, the world's largest poisonous snake, is strong enough to kill an elephant. Lizards have developed their own adaptations - some lose their tail when in danger, as a means of escaping from a predator. In time the tail will grow back again. The tail they leave behind will move and confuse the predator. What grows back will be slimmer and often a different color. For all these creatures, cold blood is definitely a competitive edge.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Africa is a land sculpted by time where animals have evolved complex weapons to arm them in the battle to live another day. An elephant's tusks can defend, or attack. An octopus uses camouflage to find food, or hide from an enemy. A Cape Fur Seal's speed and agility are valuable tools to catch a penguin, but ineffectual against a Great White Shark. A single hippopotamus holds a pride of twelve lions at bay with his sheer bulk, but backs down when faced with the piercing teeth of another hippo. With lethal weapons wielded by fearsome predators and prey, animals walk a precarious path, here among Africa's Deadliest.

programme.title: Creative Killers
programme.desc: Peppered across Africa are a few iconic locations that are renowned for killing action. Arenas bathed in a history of blood, places where Africa's icons have hunted successfully for generations. Predators here develop unique and clever ways to hunt. But the circumstances aren't the driving factor in this story. Sometimes these predators look for the perfect patch of ground to kill, a small area of long grass, or a single path that leads to the perfect ambush. How do they amplify their age-old skills by using the lie of the land? Savuti is big cat country. But only the most resourceful cats make it to the top.The Marsh Pride, Savuti's resident lions, is faced with their toughest challenge this winter: Buffalo. The complicated mix of boggy marsh, open plains and dense woodland provide extra obstacles in their path to a meal. Over centuries these heavyweights have adapted their hunting strategy to Savuti's every challenge and the buffalos' every move. And their secret: The nighttime hunt. When the sun sets, the tables begin to turn and Savuti is at the pride's mercy. But there's no shortage of challenges: Saba, the pride matriarch and most experienced hunter, has got to provide for her pride and keep them, and her territory, safe from two young male lions that are trespassing on Marsh Pride territory. It all seems doable until she gets injured after a run-in with hyenas… A lone female leopard is Savuti's ultimate innovator. Her environment has forced her to change her hunting strategy and her prey, and she's thriving!We follow three characters through Savuti's winter, starting with the disappearance of the small game and the arrival of the buffalo. The film looks at how our characters use the environment and features of the landscape to their advantage. We focus on the numerous challenges of Savuti - the things that make it such a hostile place for predators, and also highlight the inter-predatory battles between the Marsh Pride and the Nomads. We look at the challenges the young leopard is faced with while hunting under the lions' radar and trying to survive in her non-leopard-friendly environment.

programme.title: Speed Kills
programme.desc: In the forest's dark underworld, there's a lot more happening than meets the eye. Under every rock, behind every tree, death could be lurking.Africa's largest cobra is beat to the chase by the Giant bullfrog. Big Brown Bats use sonar to take out Wax moths at high speed. And the world's 2nd fastest cat leaps 10 feet into the air after its aerial prey.When death comes to the underworld, it takes the express!

programme.title: Приключения Электроника
programme.desc: Советский ученый создает гениального робота. Это мальчик, который способен решать любые математические задачи, он пишет самые лучшие сочинения и отлично поет! А еще он — точная копия школьника Сережи Сыроежкина. Сообразительный мальчуган быстренько перекладывает все свои обязанности на электронного двойника. Тот делает за него домашние задания, ходит в школу и выполняет хозяйственные дела, которые Сыроежкину поручают родители…

programme.title: Мальдивы подождут
programme.desc: Молодая успешная пара живёт в элитном посёлке. Ева разъезжает по командировкам, а Денис ждёт её дома. Но в этот раз всё пошло не по плану. Ева решает, что слишком редко проводит время с мужем, а он как раз понял, что хочет расстаться. Однако их разборки совпадают с криминальным происшествием в соседнем доме, и случайно появляется свидетель, как Денис становится заложником у Евы, потому что она не собирается отдавать своего мужа кому бы то ни было. А причём здесь Мальдивы, спросите вы?

programme.title: Три тополя на Плющихе
programme.desc: Какие они, минуты счастья? Конечно, разные. Но есть среди них и такие: сидит в такси женщина и поёт. Вернее, старательно, не очень умело выводит пронзительную мелодию: \"… Опустела без тебя земля, как мне несколько часов прожить\". Странное иногда случается в жизни. Встретились два человека — симпатичная замужняя деревенская женщина, мать двоих детей, приехавшая в Москву продавать домашнюю ветчину, и московский шофёр, человек немолодой и далеко не словоохотливый.

programme.title: Гуляй, Вася! Свидание на Бали
programme.desc: \"Хищнице\" Василисе (Любовь Аксенова), которая не давала развод своему мужу в первой части фильма "Гуляй, Вася!", опять хочется повеселиться со своими старыми друзьями и знакомыми. Только вот… у всех уже своя жизнь: у подкаблучника Паши проблемы в отношениях с женой Кирой, которая хочет отправить своего супруга к психологу. А качок Макс запустил себя и раздумывает, как ему вернуть свою бывшую Настю, которая в первой части фильма вышла замуж за Митю. Первый решает изменить своей жене с Кирой, а второй завоевать свою любовь обратно, а Кира со своим психологом хочет, чтобы в ее жизни все было нормально. Как бы то ни было, все герои встречаются на Бали, где их ждут невероятные приключения.

programme.title: Красный жемчуг любви
programme.desc: Мария молода и красива. Ее жизнь похожа на сказку, в которой желания сбываются по мановению волшебной палочки. У нее умный, любящий муж. И все, что можно купить за деньги. Мария очень хочет ребенка, но не может его родить. Она живет, но не чувствует жизни. Она очень несчастна. В порыве отчаяния Мария идет к шаману, чтобы хоть что-то сделать со своей тоской, и он гадает ей на камнях. "Ты выбрала Красный Жемчуг Любви. Кто обладает им - любит", говорит Шаман, оценив выбор Марии. На следующий день Мария встречает Григория - гонщика, каскадера и ловеласа. И влюбляется в него с первого взгляда.

programme.title: Давай разведемся!
programme.desc: В любви все средства хороши, особенно, если любовь нужно вернуть... Успешный врач Маша поглощена работой и не сразу замечает, что от нее уходит муж Миша. Жизнь переворачивается вверх дном: на работе аврал, дети требуют постоянного внимания, а привыкшая побеждать Маша не готова уступить любимого мужа красотке фитнес-тренеру Оксане. Силы, конечно, неравны. Марии уже прилично за тридцать, а сопернице совсем немного после двадцати. Но, с другой стороны, за Машиной спиной богатый жизненный опыт и двое малолетних детей. В этой ситуации она готова использовать весь свой боевой арсенал, включая потусторонние силы. К тому же новая жизнь открывает новые возможности… Комедийная мелодрама, Россия, 2019 г. Режиссеры: А.Пармас В ролях: А.Михалкова, А.Филипенко, А.Рыцарева, М.Лагашкин, С.Камынина, Ф.Лавров, Н.Маркина, М.Скородумова, М.Бурмистров, О.Альбанова

programme.title: Культурная комедия
programme.desc: Циничный пермский чиновник Виктор Летаев курирует дорожное строительство и привык всегда добиваться своего. Он знает и любит свое дело и не интересуется ничем другим. Его циничное мировоззрение меняется, когда новым вектором развития региона становятся культура и искусство. Чтобы усидеть в кресле чиновника, Виктор решает изучить культурное наследие Пермского края и начинает брать уроки у преподавателя искусствоведения Марины Николаевны.

programme.title: Земун
programme.desc: После загадочной гибели отца Егор возвращается в родную деревню, чтобы уговорить младшего брата поскорее продать совместное наследство местному предпринимателю. Однако чем больше Егор погружается в происходящее, тем яснее понимает, что ему, брату и наследию семьи угрожает большая опасность, защищаться от которой придется с оружием в руках. Тем временем ему самому все чаще видится Земун — мистическая корова, которая по поверью приходит за душами пастухов после их смерти.

Разгар лихих 1990-х, советский строй рушится. Чтобы прокормить семью, Виктор бросил науку и подался в коммунальщики. Зато теперь он всегда рядом с Леной — правда, их брак счастливым не назовёшь. Женщина мечтает выбраться из нищеты и начать свой бизнес, а муж не может определиться, за кого он — за \"белых\" или за \"красных\". Пока супруги пропадают на работе, одна в подмосковном доме прозябает дочь-подросток Таня. Скоро Октябрьский путч окончательно расколет семью, и Виктор с Леной окажутся по разные стороны баррикад.

programme.title: The Good Girl
programme.desc: A discount store clerk strikes up an affair with a stock boy who considers himself the incarnation of Holden Caulfield.Justine is a sullen 30-year-old woman stuck in a dead-end job at the Retail Rodeo department store.In addition to her mind-numbing occupation, Justine also has to contend with her dim-witted husband, Phil, and his partner, Bubba, who work as house painters when they aren't smoking pot and staring blankly at the television.Justine sees an opportunity for change, however, when she meets Holden, a fellow Retail Rodeo employee who is even more depressed than herself.The young Holden and Justine soon begin a passionate secret affair, unaware that it may not be so secret after all.

programme.title: The Humanity Bureau
programme.desc: In the near future, war, climate and political agendas have robbed America of its lush resources. Seeds rarely grow into vegetation, the water is mostly polluted, and people are obligated to work hard to earn their keep. Noah Kross (Nicolas Cage) is an agent of "the Humanity Bureau," a government agency that determines a person's productivity. Kross's reports are key factors in deciding who stays in America and who is deported to New Eden. Kross is in charge of managing the deportation of a former governor of Colorado who now lives in misery, who claims to know "the truth" before seeking to kill Kross and then being shot by him. Kross ends up discovering that New Eden is really an extermination camp where the excess unproductive population is liquidated and incinerated.

programme.title: Guido Superstar: The Rise of Guido
programme.desc: An Italian immigrant is thrust into the world of drug-lords, supercars and secret agents in this hilarious action comedy. After losing his job at the Disco Valet Company for undue heroism, Guido (Silvio Pollio) must pose as a Sicilian gangster for the FBI in order to infiltrate a powerful Asian gang. Things go sour and take a turn for the worse. Guido must now make amends before he is discovered and killed, or worse, deported.

programme.title: Summer Dreams
programme.desc: Seventeen-year old Robbie Zirpollo has a problem. As the film opens, his mother is driving him to his new summer job. We learn that Robbie has grown up in Oceanside, California, but now he and his mother have moved to Colorado for a fresh start, as his father has taken the family's savings and his secretary to Mexico. Robbie's mom has, through an uncle, gotten him a summer job at Water World on the grounds crew. The adventure begins when Robbie meets Alex and gets moved to Aokee's Surf & Snack shack to work. Alex convinces Robbie to enter the park's "Employee Olympics" to bring the Surfer King trophy to it's rightful place among the concessions crew. Tiffany, the park owner's daughter, has other ideas for Robbie.

programme.title: True Smile
programme.desc: Sergio, a 26-year-old autistic male is blind and has never seen a smile. He does, however, give everybody a sincere smile every day. A documentary based on the amazing story encapsulated by Sergio Aznarez Rosado's life.

programme.title: Score: A Hockey Musical
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Farley has led a sheltered life, raised on a diet of home schooling, organic living and trips to the art gallery. To his parents' dismay, Farley loves to play hockey with the local kids. To their even greater dismay, Farley is scouted and signed by the owner of a junior league team, where he becomes an instant star. But Farley discovers that stardom comes with a price - including the expectation to fight on the ice. Throw in a changing relationship with his best friend, and Farley finds himself losing his way.

programme.title: No Limit Kids
programme.desc: Ashton, Celeste, and Becca are three unlikely middle school outcasts who form a club in an abandoned theater. There, they meet Charlie (Bill Cobbs, Night at the Museum), a homeless man who shares their passion for musical theater. When the theater is scheduled to be torn down, the teenagers set out to save the landmark with a modern-day performance of Shakespeare's Much Ado About Nothing. Along the way, the group learns to treat others with respect and stand up for their beliefs. This Dove-approved film also features Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Lee Meriwether.

programme.title: The Sandman
programme.desc: One fine morning, Benno finds sand in his bed. While he tries to ignore this at first, he soon must realize that he himself is loosing the sand. Day after day the sand increases and soon his time literally starts running short. Finally he is left no choice but to ask Sandra for help, who runs a small coffee shop under his apartment. Although Benno hates her with a passion, he started having dreams of her every night. What could Sandra and the dreams have to do with the sand?

programme.title: Irish Jam
programme.desc: A South Central L.A. con artist with rap skills tries to keep bill collectors and his lover, with marriage in mind, at bay by entering a poetry contest staged by a small Irish town. Can his rhyming skills help the town and win him the prize money?

programme.title: Cookies Fortune
programme.desc: Cookie's Fortune unfolds over an eventful Easter weekend in the small town of Holly Springs, Mississippi. The town residents are peaceful, kind folk--with the exception of Camille Dixon (Glenn Close) - a pushy theatre director with an incredibly shy younger sister, Cora (Julianne Moore), whose estranged daughter Emma (Liv Tyler) has just returned to town. On the heels of her latest play, Camille is shocked to discover that her Aunt Jewel Mae "Cookie" Orcutt (Patricia Neal) has committed suicide. Terrified at the thought of how this will tarnish the family name, she eats the suicide note to make it look like a burglary. This set-up leads the police to one main suspect, Willis Richland (Charles S. Dutton), who also happens to be Cookie's best friend. Although the rest of the town is convinced Willis didn't commit the crime, an outside investigator (Courtney B. Vance) isn't so sure. As Easter Sunday and opening night of the play arrive, the truth comes out, revealing more secrets than anyone could have possibly imagined.

programme.title: Cell
programme.desc: John Cusack and Samuel L Jackson star in director Tod Williams' horror, from screenplay adapted from his own novel by Stephen King. It's a normal day at Boston International Airport, with travellers on their way to and from their destinations, and airport, airline and security staff going about their business, and most of them using their mobile phones. Among them is Clay Riddell (Cusack), who's talking to his estranged wife and their young son, until his battery dies and he switches to a payphone. The inconvenience saves his life: just as his cash runs out, everyone using a mobile device around him receives an electronic pulse that causes agony and then turns them into uncontrollable ultraviolent killers. Clay narrowly escapes the mayhem and finds shelter in the paralysed subway system below the airport, where train driver Tom McCourt (Jackson) offers to lead the survivors to safety on foot. But the incident is a nationwide phenomenon, so getting out of the airport is just the start of their battle to stay alive.

programme.title: Unexpected
programme.desc: Bob and Amy are at a crossroads: she wants to adopt a child, he doesn't. Will renovating their house and rescuing animals solve their problems? Will their new handyman and his son's pregnant girlfriend be the miracle they're looking for?...

programme.title: Hit List
programme.desc: Charlotte is a woman with anger management issues whose therapist suggests she write a journal to keep her emotions in check. Unlucky in love, she ventures online to find a boyfriend. Just as she reaches her limit of unsuccessful dates, Charlotte meets her soul mate Lyle. Everything is perfect until Lyle finds Charlottes journal and sets out to prove just how deeply he loves her.

programme.title: Operation Chromite
programme.desc: In 1950, just a few months after North Korean forces have overrun most of South Korea, an American-led United Nations Command is deployed to Korea to aid the struggling South Koreans. General Douglas MacArthur devises a secret plan to attack behind enemy lines at the port city of Incheon. The risky strategy is opposed by leaders of the other military branches, forcing MacArthur to devise a clandestine operation to gather essential information from within occupied Incheon by coordinating a weeklong South Korean intelligence operation known as "X-Ray".

programme.desc: Filmzone'i filme tutvustavad treilerid.

programme.title: Hr Õige
programme.desc: Parimatel päevadel hüperaktiivne Martha on pärast viimast lahkuminekut täiesti kontrolli kaotanud. Ta laliseb, pidutseb nagu loom, teeb söögiks kõik, mis talle ette jääb, ja tahab teha midagi kohutavat, aga siis kohtab ta ootamatult Francist. Igale teisele tunduks Francise lähenemiskatsed jubedad, kuid Marthas tekib paratamatult huvi. Nad paistavad ideaalne paar: Martha on segane, Francis on segane… Ainult et Francis on surmavat sorti segane. Ta on professionaalne palgamõrvar.

programme.title: Plekksepp, rätsep, sõdur, nuhk
programme.desc: Suurbritannia, Prantsusmaa, Saksamaa 2011 põnevik Lavastaja: Tomas Alfredson Osades: Gary Oldman, Colin Firth, Tom Hardy, John Hurt, Toby Jones, Mark Strong On aasta 1973. 20. sajandi keskpaigas alanud külm sõda kahjustab jätkuvalt rahvusvahelisi suhteid. Briti Salateenistus MI6 ehk koodinimega Tsirkus, katsub sammu pidada teiste riikide spionaažiga ning kindlustada Suurbritannia julgeolekut. Tsirkuse juht (John Hurt), keda tuntakse Kontrolli nime all, saadab Ungarisse agendi - Jim Prideaux (Mark Strong). Jimi missioon lendab aga vastu taevast. Tsirkusest sunnitakse lahkuma nii Kontroll kui ka üks tema parimaid leitnante ja terava vaistuga ambitsioonikaid nuhke, George Smiley (Gary Oldman). Oma naisest Annist võõrdunud Smiley palgatakse salaja uuesti ametisse, sest Tsirkusesse on arvatavalt imbunud topeltagent ehk teisisõnu "mutt", kes töötab Nõukogude Liidu heaks ja ohustab Inglismaa julgeolekut. Topeltagendi paljastamisse on segatud ka Smiley aastakümnete tagune kokkupuude salapärase vene meisterspiooni Karlaga. "Mutti" ei suudeta kuidagi tuvastada, kuni omal käel tegutsev agent Ricki Tarr (Tom Hardy) võtab ootamatult ühendust oma ülemuse Guillamiga. Samal ajal saab Smiley teada, et Kontroll on "muti" kahtlusaluste nimekirja koondanud viis meest: ambitsioonika Percy Alleline'i (Toby Jones), kelle koodinimi on Plekksepp; sarmikalt enesekindla Bill Haydoni (Colin Firth) ehk Rätsepa; Roy Blandi (Ciarán Hinds), keda hüütakse Sõduriks; Toby Esterhase'i (David Dencik) kelle koodinimi on Vaenemees; ja - Smiley enda ehk Nuhi. Veel enne, kui selgub jahmatav tõde, tuleb rahvusvahelisse spioonimängu segatud asjaosalistel maksta lõivu, ja veel millist. "Plekksepp, rätsep, sõdur, nuhk" on John le Carré menuromaani kauaoodatud ekraniseering.

programme.title: Patriootide päev
programme.desc: Põnevusdraama 2013. aastal Bostoni maratonil kärgatanud plahvatusest... Politseiseersant Tommy Saunders (Mark Wahlberg ), vaprad ellujääjad, sündmuspaigale saabunud esmaabitöötajad ja uurijad jooksevad kohutava terroriakti järel ajaga võidu, et järgmist rünnakut ära hoida. Eriagent Richard Deslauriersi (Kevin Bacon), politseiülem Ed Davise (John Goodman), seersant Jeffrey Pugliese (J.K. Simmons) ja medõe Carol Saundersi (Michelle Monaghan) põimuvad lood loovad ajaloo keerukaima ja põnevaima inimjahi.

programme.title: Head tüübid
programme.desc: USA 2016 komöödia Lavastaja:Shane Black Osades: Russell Crowe, Ryan Gosling, Angourie Rice Filmi tegevus leiab aset Los Angeleses 1970. aastatel. Edutu eradetektiiv Holland March (Gosling) ja löömamees Jackson Healy (Crowe) peavad üheskoos lahendama kadunud tüdruku juhtumi ja pealtnäha sellest eraldiseisva pornotähe surmaloo. Juurdluse käigus paljastavad nad šokeeriva vandenõu, mis viib võimuladvikuni välja.

programme.title: Mida me pimeduses teeme
programme.desc: Võttegrupp tutvustab meile Vladislavi, Viagot ja Deaconit, erinevatest ajastutest pärit võluvaid vampiire, kes kommunaalkulude ja igavuse vältimiseks elavad juba viimase sajandi ühise katuse all ning jagavad lisaks oma saagile ka huvi näiteks ööelu ja libahuntidega tülitsemise vastu. Nende majapidamise ja elude habras tasakaal paisatakse aga segi, kui keldris elav mitmetuhandeaastane Petyr teeb vampiiri ka edevast ja hoolimatust Nickist.

programme.title: Pints Zamundaast 2
programme.desc: TELE-ESILINASTUS! Zamunda monarh Akeem saab teada, et tal on USA-s kaua kadunud poeg ning ta peab naasma Ameerikasse, et kohtuda selle ootamatu pärijaga ja luua temaga suhe.

programme.title: Soosik
programme.desc: Iirimaa, Suurbritannia,USA 2018 komöödia, draamaLavastaja:Yorgos LanthimosOsades:Emma Stone, Rachel Weisz, Nicholas Hoult18. sajandi hakul on pea kõik Inglismaa mehed hõivatud üksteise mahanottimisega Hispaania pärilussõjas. Kummalisel kombel haigestunud kuninganna Anne (Veneetsia festivalil parima naisnäitleja auhinna võitnud Olivia Colman) igavleb luksuslikus palees oma voodis. Tema naeruväärse imetluse on pälvinud 17 armsat jänkukest ja ta osaleb alati ekstravagantsetel meelelistel üritustel, kuid lükkab olulisemad kohustused oma ustava sõbranna Sarah (Oscari-võitja Rachel Weisz) kaela. Marlborough' hertsoginna kutsub palee toateenijaks veetleva, kuid ujeda nõbu Abigaili (Oscari-võitja Emma Stone). Petlikuna näiv kuninglik rahu ja peomeeleolu ei jää aga kauaks kestma, kui need kolm kuritahtlikku ja kalki naist hakkavad tunnetama armastuse varjatud piire eri moel.

programme.title: Llewyn Davise ballaad
programme.desc: Kahele Oscarile kandideerinud draamakomöödia, mille autorid on legendaarsed vennad Joel ja Ethan Coen ("Fargo"). Film räägib 1960ndate alguse New Yorgi muusikamaastikust. Folkmuusik Llewyn Davisel veab elus kõik viltu. Tema on see mees, kellest ei saanud Bob Dylanit. Llewyni bänd on lagunenud, soolokarjäär ei saa hoogu sisse ja tüdruksõber on endale uue kallima leidnud. "Llewyn Davise ballaad" jälgib mehe katseid artistina edu saavutada ja kuidagi oma elu korda seada. Film võitis Cannes'i festivalil žürii Grand Prize'i. Osades Oscar Isaac ("Ohtlik sõit"), Justin Timberlake ("Sotsiaalvõrgustik"), Carey Mulligan ("Suur Gatsby") jt.

programme.title: Hoia end
programme.desc: Pärast auto alla jäämist naaseb naine koju ja avastab, et tema sõbrad ei taha teda tegelikult aidata. Meeleheitlikult abi otsides pöördub ta aga ootamatu inimese poole.

programme.title: Vabasta mind kahtlusest
programme.desc: Vankumatu demineerija kaotab äkitselt jalgealuse, kui saab teada, et mees, keda ta on alati oma isaks pidanud, ei olegi tema bioloogiline isa. Hoolimata hellusest, mida ta tunneb mehe vastu, kes ta üles kasvatas, asub ta vaikselt otsima oma tõelist isa.

programme.title: Armastuse teekond
programme.desc: Ellie on kaua ja kaunikesti aidanud oma õel pulmi planeerida. Külalised on vaikselt rannahotelli kokku kogunema hakanud, kuid keda kohal pole on pruutpaar. Juhtumisi on isameheks Ellie ekspeika Greg, kellega tuleb nüüd kiirelt plaab B välja mõelda, et külalised maha rahustada. Pulmapäev läheneb ohtliku kiirusega. Ellie ja Greg peavad kriisiolukorras tihedat koostööd tegema ja ühtäkki hakkavad nad taasavastama, miks nad ise kunagi teineteisesse nii armunud olid.

programme.title: Lagritsapitsa
programme.desc: "Lagritsapitsa" on lugu Alana Kane'ist (Alana Haim) ja Gary Valentine'ist (Cooper Hoffman), kes jooksevad ringi, kasvavad ja armuvad 1973. aasta palavas Los Angeleses, püüdes orienteeruda esimese armastuse ohtlikel radadel.

programme.title: Семейные мелодрамы
programme.desc: Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.title: Окно жизни
programme.desc: Славик и Надежда оказываются жертвами квартирных аферистов, поэтому после рождения второго ребёнка они вынуждены жить с семьёй Славика. Его сестра Алёна недовольна таким соседством. Славик уезжает на заработки. Пользуясь тем, что Славик в коме, Алёна выгоняет Надежду с детьми из квартиры. После длительных скитаний Надежда оставляет младенца в бэби-боксе. Соколова и Борадзе предлагают Глаше уволиться по собственному желанию. Борадзе сообщает коллективу о том, что подкидыша усыновила семья Нескоромовых. Коллектив перинатального центра прощается с Милославской - сердце коллеги остановилось. Славик выходит из комы, Алёна признается ему в своем вранье.

programme.title: Женский доктор
programme.desc: Действие разворачивается в новой современной клинике, которую основал профессор Юрий Климов. Бывшему тестю доктора Романа Широкова остался лишь год до выхода на пенсию, и за это время он должен найти достойного преемника. Но это не главная причина, по которой профессор вновь приглашает Романа работать вместе. Роман Широков – единственный, кто может довести до конца инновационную научную разработку, от которой зависит судьба дочери профессора - Нины. Однако инвесторы и сотрудники клиники не рады появлению нового профессионала.

programme.title: Шанс на любовь
programme.desc: Оля Мельникова работает переводчицей в брачном агентстве "Шанс". Она ведет переписку от имени женщин, которые мечтают выйти замуж за иностранцев. Ее тексты пользуются успехом. Сама же девушка о любви не думает. Как преданная сестра, она заботится о старшем брате Борисе, прикованного к инвалидной коляске. Однажды, получив очередное задание от вздорной и самовлюбленной клиентки Анжелы, Оля вступает в переписку с молодым англичанином Генри. programme.title: Дневники Темного
programme.desc: Телеканал ТЕТ подготовил для вас нечто очень неожиданное. Проект придется по вкусу всем любителям загадочных мистических историй. События происходят в фантастическом городе Темный. В нем живут вампиры, оборотни и другие существа. Все здесь живет и дышит, даже стены домов. Попасть в этот загадочный город совсем не сложно, а вот покинуть - невероятно сложно. Однажды в город приезжает журналист. Его задача - освещать события, происходящие в Темном. Однако все осложняется тем, что отличить где правда, а где только галлюцинации, в городе бывает невероятно трудно. В каждом выпуске он расследует новые мистические дела. Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

programme.title: Семейные мелодрамы
programme.desc: Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.title: The Last War
programme.desc: "The Last War" is a documentary research project where leading thinkers from Ukraine and the West deconstruct the real history of the confrontation with Russia. The focus is on the true chronological framework of the conflict, which goes far beyond the last few years, and the phenomenon of Ukrainian resistance. The project clearly demonstrates how the myth of the Kremlin's "invincibility" is crumbling on the battlefield, and answers the main question: what will the world become after the collapse of the last empire and what will be considered Ukraine's final victory.

The project clearly demonstrates how the myth of the Kremlin's "invincibility" is crumbling on the battlefield, and answers the main question: what will the world become after the collapse of the last empire and what will be considered Ukraine's final victory.

programme.title: News reports
programme.desc: The program delivers comprehensive reports on current events, providing viewers with detailed information on politics, society, economy, and culture. Episodes present facts clearly and objectively, offering analysis and context to help audiences understand complex issues. By following the program, viewers stay informed about local and global developments, gain insight into ongoing events, and make sense of important news with accuracy and reliability.

programme.title: FreeDOM
programme.desc: Viewers follow the transformation of homes, renovation projects, and community initiatives in an engaging and informative way. Each episode highlights practical solutions, creative design ideas, and real-life stories, offering inspiration for personal living spaces. The program combines entertainment with useful insights, helping audiences discover innovative ways to enhance comfort, style, and functionality at home.

programme.title: U-Boat Wargamers
programme.desc: WATU faces a crucial encounter for ONS.5 in the Battle of the Atlantic. Dönitz unleashes the new torpedo that targets the escort ships. Roberts and Laidlaw must counteract the new weapon and recapture the waves.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: The Curse of Civil War Gold
programme.desc: Treasure hunters Rick and Marty Lagina, the stars of History's "The Curse of Oak Island," learn of a new mystery that may even rival Oak Island's. Michigan native Kevin Dykstra is obsessed with a deathbed confession made by a lighthouse keeper in the 1890s about a national treasure dating back to the Civil War. The story goes that Union soldiers tracked down Confederate president Jefferson Davis in 1865 and confiscated his gold. The stolen loot was smuggled north some years later but ended up in Lake Michigan, where Dykstra believes it still remains. His quest to prove it ultimately takes him and his team to the bottom of Lake Michigan.

programme.title: Gold Hunters: Legend of the Superstition Mountains
programme.desc: Legend tells of the Lost Dutchman's gold mine hidden somewhere within the 160,000 acres of brutal Arizona desert known as the "Superstition Mountains." The promise of a $200 million mother lode has lured thousands of treasure hunters and continues to claim the lives of those eager to decipher the legend's clues and riddles. Hunting for the Lost Dutchman is typically a one-man journey, but lifelong Dutch Hunter Wayne Tuttle is breaking with tradition and partnering with a team of experts to follow a newly revealed clue that could finally solve the 500-year-old mystery of America's most famous and deadliest buried treasure. With cursed mountains said to drive men mad and a hidden fortune of gold worth killing for, the treasure hunter's greatest danger may be the man at his side. Trust at your own peril if you dare to tread into HISTORY's Legend of the Superstition Mountains.

programme.title: Warriors
programme.desc: Former Green Berry Terry Schappert explores the stories of some of the most iconic warrior groups in history, including their weaponry, training, fighting tactics and more. The veteran investigates what made these legendary fighters great, but also what were their weaknesses. Join him as he looks into the battling masteries of the Vikings, the Samurai, the Spartans and more.

programme.title: Evolve
programme.desc: Throughout the eons of its existence, the natural world has played host to this never-ending competition called life. Since the dawn of time, roughly 99 percent of all species have become extinct. In order to survive, all creatures, including man, must treat life as a battlefield and master the natural weapons and defenses that they have evolved: Tyrannosaurus Rex's 13-inch canines; the Gecko's velcro-like toe pads; the Bald Eagle's telescopic vision capable of spotting a hare a mile away. How did these attributes, each unique to the organism itself, appear? Certainly not arbitrarily. They evolved for a common reason - to give these animals a critical edge in inter-species warfare, and to ensure the survival of the individual's genes into the next generation. To evolve is to survive!

programme.title: Lost Worlds
programme.desc: Documentary series that brings back to life lost cities, structures, cultures, and civilisations, transporting viewers back in time and revealing the truth behind some of history's most iconic eras. Using a combination of cutting-edge technology and archaeological research, the team detail what life was like for these places during their peak of their powers, and use visual overlays to compare past and present landscapes. From the Knights Templar to the lost city of Atlantis, ancient Egypt to Hitler's planned supercity, and ancient Athens to America's wild west, each episodes dives into these extraordinary remnants of human history.

programme.title: Brad Meltzer's Decoded
programme.desc: What if the history you knew was only half the story? Brad Meltzer's Decoded investigates the other half: the secret history of the symbols and codes that surround us everyday. Best-selling author Brad Meltzer has been writing novels for more than a decade. He has studied and written about some of the most revered institutions and documents in human history, including the U.S. Supreme Court, the Presidency, the Secret Service, Wall Street and the Bible. Brad has assembled a team to investigate the countless clues and theories uncovered through his years of research, but unexplored until now. From the dollar bill to the first Presidential Codes, the hidden messages of the Statue of Liberty and the ciphers protecting the location of lost Confederate gold, the team uncovers the truth behind history's most provocative secrets.

programme.title: Rome: Rise & Fall of an Empire
programme.desc: It is 47 AD. The new emperor Claudius has lost the respect of those he seeks to rule. He can only hang onto his throne by waging a spectacular conquest. He chooses Britannia, a legendary land which fascinates and inspires fear in the Romans. Proud and warlike, the Britons use the island's treacherous terrain and dark forests to lure the legions to ruin. Led by magic wielding Druid priests and a charismatic warrior named Caratacus, the Britons resist in the face of the greatest military machine the world has ever known.

programme.title: Rome: Rise & Fall of an Empire
programme.desc: It is the beginning of the third century and Rome is in crisis. Ravaged by civil war and foreign invasions, it now faces an even greater challenge - the new religion of Christianity. When barbarian Goths attack the Empire's borders, and traitors rise against Emperor Philip, his trusted general Decius blames Philip's leniency toward the Christians. But Decius soon becomes a traitor, as well, as he faces Philip in battle, taking the crown for himself. As emperor, Decius sets out to win back the pagan gods' favour, and his reign's first victims are the Christians. Yet the wrath of the gods only continues as plague strikes and the Goths launch full-scale invasions into the Empire. Decius and his son, Herennius, are forced to meet the Gothic king, Cniva, in a deadly clash that will mark the first time a Roman emperor is ever killed by a barbarian in battle. Unfortunately for the Empire, it will not be the last.

programme.title: Missing in Alaska
programme.desc: The Alaska Triangle, a region in northwest Alaska, has more unsolved missing person cases than anywhere else in the world. Over 20,000 people have vanished in the past 50 years alone. Who or what's behind these cases is unknown. Some believe it's the work of local predators or simply the rugged, dangerous terrain, but legends thrive in Alaska, and the ominous history of disappearances in the area has drawn comparisons to the Bermuda Triangle. Working together with local experts and eyewitnesses, our team of investigators will go case-by-case to gather evidence, conduct tests, examine history and explore local myths to determine the most viable explanation for the disappearances, all while trying to understand the sinister mystery that is the Alaska Triangle.

programme.title: Lost Relic Hunters
programme.desc: Lost Relic Hunters follows the work of one of the world's most prolific collectors of antiquities, Hamilton White, and his long-time friend and business partner, Carl Cookson. The intrepid duo are back on the trail of some truly astonishing relics and historical pieces, which, if authenticated, will potentially change our understanding of some of the most iconic periods of British and European history. Aided in their adventures by cultural and art historian Dr Janina Ramirez, Lost Relic Hunters sees Carl and Hamilton journey to breath-taking locations around the world including Venice, Istanbul, Barcelona, Jerusalem and the Pyrenees, in their quest to authenticate the rare and precious antiquities from Hamilton's collection.

programme.title: Азия 360
programme.desc: Что вы знаете о Центральной Азии? То, что эти страны когда-то входили в состав СССР, и то, что люди сейчас там живут бедно, живут в кишлаках и ездят на ослах, мечтают переехать в Россию и работать там, пьют только зеленый чай и едят плов и мясо, притесняют людей других национальностей? Мы решили развеять самые распространенные мифы о Центральной Азии, а также рассказать о забытых традициях и блюдах, которые шокируют иностранцев, а иногда даже самих местных.

programme.title: Два с половиной человека
programme.desc: Закоренелый холостяк Чарли, постоянно опасающийся за свою свободу, и его брат Алан, недавно разошедшийся с женой, живут под одной крышей. Чарли только и делает, что заводит любовные интрижки, а Алан всеми силами пытается от него не отстать. В свободное от амурных приключений время братья воспитывают десятилетнего сынишку Алана Джейка.

programme.title: Два с половиной человека

programme.title: Лучик
programme.desc: Глеб живёт в своё удовольствие, ни в чем себе не отказывая. Ни к чему и ни к кому он не привязывается надолго и семьёй обзаводиться не собирается. Но наследник - другое дело, наследник ему нужен. Он обращается в агентство и нанимает Машу, которая должна родить ему сына, получить деньги и исчезнуть. Но как-то так все складывается после рождения сына, что Маша остается в доме Глеба, ведет хозяйство, воспитывает сына, которого все зовут Лучик за его счастливую улыбку. Проходит семь лет, и Глеб понимает, что уже наигрался в семью и возвращается к прежнему разгульному образу жизни. Маша, не желая с этим мириться, уезжает с ребенком. И начинается жестокая битва за сына. На стороне Глеба - лучшие адвокаты, деньги, связи, наконец, закон. На стороне Маши - только любовь Лучика.

programme.title: Мой любимый враг
programme.desc: От любви до ненависти – один шаг, а от ненависти до любви – долгий путь… Студенты Кира и Марк влюбились, но отец не уверен, что может доверить нищему студенту свою единственную дочь. Марк решает уехать из города и доказать, что достоин Киры. Она воспринимает разлуку как предательство любимого и уезжает за границу строить карьеру. Через 10 лет Кира приезжает в родной город и неожиданно встречает Марка, который вернулся из-за нее. Он решает доказать Кире, что изменился – становится соперником мэра на выборах. Для Киры это еще одного доказательство, что ей стоит держаться от Марка подальше. Она знакомится с правой рукой отца – адвокатом Глебом. Вспыхивает роман. И Кира принимает предложение Глеба выйти за него замуж…

programme.title: Госпожа Фазилет и ее дочери
programme.desc: Госпожа Фазилет после того, как потеряла мужа, одна воспитывает двух дочек. Вся жизнь Фазилет прошла в сожалениях, поэтому теперь ее вкладом в будущее стала младшая дочь Эдже. Но самым большим препятствием на пути матери является старшая дочь Хазан, которая несмотря на свою изысканную красоту ведет себя по-мальчишески и не ладит с матерью. Семья Эймен богата, могущественна, у них особняк на берегу Босфора, и однажды их пути пересекаются с Фазилет и ее дочерьми. Богатство Эймен даже превосходит мечты Фазилет. После знакомства с ними изменится не только жизнь Эдже, но и Хазан, которая влюбится в Синана Эймена, избалованного сына семьи.

programme.title: Я иду тебя искать
programme.desc: Герои расследуют дело гибели журналистки, которая без ведома редакции вела частное расследование об убийстве легендарной актрисы советского кино, а также жены владельца авиаремонтного предприятия, погибшей в смертельном ДТП. Вместо Самойлова новым начальником УВД становится амбициозный и молодой для такой должности Андрей Заморенов. Мила скрывает от всех начавшиеся отношения со Швецом. Но влюбленность дочери не ускользает от проницательного отца.

programme.desc: Ежедневная информационная программа Настоящего времени.

programme.title: Лицом к событию
programme.desc: Лидер в той или иной сфере общественной жизни - человек известный и информированный - под перекрестным огнем вопросов ведущих программы Михаила Соколова и Елены Рыковцевой.

programme.title: Ольга
programme.desc: Татьяна решает забрать Марьяну из долбанутой семейки Терентьевых, привлекая на свою сторону сотрудников службы опеки. Володя обещает Ольге помочь справиться с соцслужбой, чего бы это ему ни стоило. Юргену выпадает хороший шанс вернуться на достойную работу и реабилитироваться в глазах Ольги, осталось вспомнить старые таланты. Аня с подругами воплощает в жизнь собственный план по возвращению Марьяши…

programme.title: Ольга
programme.desc: Ольга, Володя и Аня бросаются в погоню за Малышевыми, сбежавшими с украденным ребёнком в Екатеринбург. Юрген недоволен своей ролью в операции по спасению правнучки, решает вернуть ее сам. Чича не бросает старого друга, и они вместе пытаются догнать беглецов на Чичиной \"Оке\". Пользуясь тем, что семейство в отлучке, Тимофей решает устроить вечеринку и пригласить на неё соседку Сашу. Чича и Юрген открывают неожиданные грани своей дружбы.

programme.title: Голое влечение
programme.desc: Скандальный цикл передач, в которых люди находят потенциальных спутников жизни, обнаженные тела которых им показывают. Затем они должны будут сами раздеться и сделать выбор.

programme.title: Анатомия убийства
programme.desc: Жизнь элитного подмосковного поселка полна тайн, а о способности Евгении Волковой разгадывать эти самые тайны известно всем. Популярная актриса просит Евгению разобраться со странными явлениями, которые происходят в доме - ей кажется, что кто-то планомерно сводит ее с ума. Евгения и Карский пытаются распутать клубок интриг, в центре которых оказалась актриса, и не замечают, что в их ближайшем окружении тоже не все ладно. И вот однажды исчезает помощник Карского - скромный парень Гриша. Пытаясь разыскать его, герои понимают, что он совсем не тот, за кого себя выдавал. Зачем наследнику огромного состояния работать за гроши? И куда он делся?

programme.title: Erin Burnett OutFront
programme.desc: Hosted by Erin Burnett, an expert in political science and economics, OutFront is an hour-long news programme examining the latest stories from the US and further afield. Broadcast live from either the New York studio or live on location from the site of a breaking story, the show features insightful opinions from informed guests. With expert analysis from CNN's correspondents and analysis from the show's panel, Erin Burnett OutFront dissects the stories of the day, leaving no stone unturned. Burnett, a former financial analyst for Goldman Sachs, uses her forthright approach to engage interviewees in honest discussion.

programme.title: Anderson Cooper 360
programme.desc: Anderson Cooper delves into the day's news, looking beyond the broadcast to give his take, prompting us to re-think what we hear in the headlines. Cooper has covered major, international stories like the aftermath of Hurricane Katrina on the Gulf Coast, the catastrophic BP oil spill and the 2010 earthquake in Haiti, which saw the whole world fall silent. The show has won an absolute plethora of awards over the years, including GLAAD Media and Emmy awards.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: Gumball Darwin and Carrie team up to convince their fellow students that the school is haunted. At Halloween show and tell the class isn't buying Gumball's story about Gargaroth The Devourer until Carrie fakes a terrifying haunting. The kids convince the school to hire them as ghost exterminators and take their payment in Halloween candy. But when it turns out Gargaroth is real suddenly Gumball is expected to be the town's saviour.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: Gumball is walking in the same direction as Hot Dog Guy and with each step it becomes increasingly awkward. Gumball is too busy singing about ketchup to notice he's about to bump into Hot Dog Guy. They manage to get through an awkward moment only to discover they're travelling in the same direction. Their journey becomes increasingly awkward until a delusional mall cop tries to arrest them and in the process allows them to finally go their separate ways…

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: Elmore residents are going missing and the cause of these disappearances may be closer to home than Gumball and Darwin think. A breaking news report tells the Wattersons that their neighbour is among the several mysterious disappearances happening across Elmore. Their search for clues leads them to find a strange egg which they soon discover belongs to their own Evil Turtle. The family realise that it's their responsibility to track down their pet before she and her brood do more damage to the town.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: Gumball and Darwin agree to do all of Tobias's chores in exchange for good points! Gumball and Darwin discover that Tobias is doing way better than them in an online game called Galatrek. Tobias admits he earns "good points" doing chores for his parents which he then exchanges for dollars to buy cool stuff for Galatrek. If Gumball and Darwin do Tobias' chores they can earn his "good points" and use them for Galatrek. Gumball and Darwin think they've hit the jackpot. But these "good points" may not be quite as good as Tobias claims...

programme.title: The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball‌
programme.desc: In Elmore, reality bends and family life gets weird. Gumball pulls Darwin, Anais, and the whole town into adventures - from fighting evil fast food to dealing with an AI crushing on his mom. The show's so wild, it needed a new name.

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: Clarence
programme.desc: Follow the daily adventures of a 10-year-old boy named Clarence, and his two best friends Sumo and Jeff. Clarence lives with his mother Mary and her boyfriend Chad in the fictional town of Aberdale, and he is optimistic, curious, honest and quirky boy, who sees the best in everyone and gets himself in a variety of funny situations and everyday problems, which he solves with lots of imagination and with the help from his friends.

programme.title: Clarence
programme.desc: Clarence's Millions: While Clarence realizes the classroom "buddy star" system is leaving some kids behind, he creates his own form of currency called "Clarence Dollars." The new reward system promptly turns the entire school upside down. / Clarence Gets a Girlfriend: When Clarence is asked out on a date by Ashley, a girl in his class, he realizes he doesn't know the first thing about having a girlfriend! Clarence enlists Sumo and Jeff to transform himself into the perfect gentleman...just in time for his big date.

programme.title: Lana Longbeard
programme.desc: Lana is a super-feisty, forward-thinking and passionate 11-year-old girl, who is also the heir to her father's adventuring ship, the Mighty Windbreaker. Along with her captain dad and his diverse crew (an orc, a dwarf, a barbarian and a cyclops), she sails across the Ten Realms, dreaming of becoming one of the greatest adventurers of all time. But first, she must overcome some challenging obstacles: impulsivity, stubbornness, extreme curiosity, disdain for rules … and a love of pancakes. All the best things about her!

Elu hakkab probleemseks minema siis, kui nende ukse taha saabub Liis - Hannese tütar tema eelmisest abielust. Intriige punuvad ka naabrid, tuttavad ja sugulased.

programme.title: Papad Mammad
programme.desc: Volli kingib pisikesele Lennale põrsa ja see tekitab lõpuks kogu külas skandaali ja seagripi paanika. Siga peab majapidamisest kaduma! Lõpuks peavad papad-mammad Lennale tervet loomaaeda mängima, et asja kuidagi siluda.

programme.title: Kälimehed
programme.desc: Telelavastuse tegevus toimub ühe vaikse Eesti linnakese vaiksel kõrvaltänaval. Vaikelu saab aga rikutud, kui Urmase ja Riina kõrvalmajja kolib Riina õde Rebekka koos oma uue mehe Raivoga. Saatuse tahtel naabriteks ja kälimeesteks saanud Urmas ja Raivo on inimestena erinevad ning nende õdedest elukaaslased omavahel nagistanud lapsest saadik. Lavastuses näeme, kuidas üleaedsed peavad lahendama igale eestlasele nii tuttavaid probleeme naabrite läbikäimises ning mismoodi aitavad sellele kaasa õdede ellu sekkuv ema ning Raivo hämaravõitu äripartner Viks. Mängivad Peeter Oja, Sepo Seeman, Merle Palmiste, Hilje Murel, Ene Järvis, Andrus Vaarik, Jan Uuspõld, Ivo Eensalu jpt.

programme.title: Nurjatud tüdrukud
programme.desc: "Nurjatud tüdrukud" on musta huumori ja põnevusega vürtsitatud draamasari, mille tegevuspaigaks on raskestikasvatavate tüdrukute kinnine õppeasutus. Sinna saabub eraeluprobleemide käest põgenev kriminaalpsühholoog Markus Tamm, kes satub silmitsi uute ja eelmisest veelgi keerulisemate probleemidega. Markusega samal päeval saabub kooli uus õpilane Hanna, kes on peamine kahtlusalune tuntud ärimehe mõrvas.

programme.title: Kerge elu
programme.desc: Toomas ja tema naine Stella elavad koos oma kahe teismelise lapsega pealtnäha unistuste elu. Keegi ei või arvatagi, et pereisal on minevikust kahe miljoni suurune käendusvõlg ja et seda peret hoitakse üleval ainult kuritegevusega. Kui aga Toomasele tuleb pakkumine osaleda suures raharöövis, ei aima veel keegi, kui halvasti asjad minema hakkavad. Osades Margus Prangel, Helena Merzin, Mirjam Aimla ja Siim Sups. Režissöör Raoul Suvi, stsenarist Mikko Pölla.

programme.title: Yellowstone
programme.desc: Kõrgelt hinnatud vestern, kus Ameerika suurima rantšo peremees John Dutton (Kevin Costner) peab koos perega kaitsma oma valdusi kõigi vastu, kellega nende maa-alad piirnevad. Duttoni pere maid ihkavad nii laienev linn, indiaanlaste reservaat kui ka Ameerika esimene rahvuspark.

Igaüks üritab endale pidevalt kaaslast leida ning vahest ka teiselt üle trumbata.

programme.desc: Õed ja kooliõed Riina ja Rebekka (Hilje Murel ja Merle Palmiste) plaanivad kooli kokkutulekule minekut. Oodatud on ka nende kaaslased, aga uhke Raivo (Peeter Oja) kõrval tundub Merlele Riina mees Urmas (Sepo Seeman) peo jaoks liiga räsitud väljanägemisega, seda paneb tähele isegi Maalehe fotograaf (Ago Anderson), kes Angervaksa teel nunnukonkursi pilte teeb. Appi kutsutakse kuulus moekunstnik (Jan Uuspõld), kes lööb kogu seltskonna uhkelt üles.

programme.title: Beverly Hills, 90210
programme.desc: Kõik lähevad Rolling Stonesi kontserdile. Kelly saab ajakirja kaudu VIP-pääsme lava taha. Brandon palub oma presidendiameti kaitsmiseks Jesselt abi. Dylan ja Valerie lepivad kokku, et nad ei kohtu enam,.

programme.title: Skandaal
programme.desc: Endine USA Presidendi meediasuhete konsultant Olivia Pope on nüüd kriisijuht, kes suudab lahendada kõik probleemid nii, et keegi ei teagi, et sellised probleemid olemas olid. Kuid ükskõik kui hoolas sa oled oma töös, võid samal ajal enda eraelus väga palju kahju teha. Igal nädalal seisavad Olivia ja ta meeskond silmitsi paljude probleemidega, mis vajavad lahendamist. Ning kui nad suudavad päästa teiste inimeste elusid, ei tähenda see seda, et nad suudavad parandada ka enda omi.

programme.desc: aastal otsib Frank ikka veel Claire'i. 1743. aastal üritab Claire enda ja Jamie abieluga leppida.

programme.title: Rannavalve
programme.desc: Mitch ja vetelpäästjad teevad koostööd rannavalvega, et päästa Hobie, Gayle ja Ken lennukist. Hobie püüab Keni lohutada, Gayle on aga kinni jäänud. Matt otsustab kolida Stephanie ja C. J. juurde elama. Rannavalve meeskond aitab Jackiel ja Summeril oma uut restorani pidulikuks avamiseks ette valmistada.

programme.title: Papad Mammad
programme.desc: Naabrimees Mitskini poeg tahab abielluda, aga juhtumisi on tema õppejõuks ülikoolis meie papa-Jüri, kes ei taha poisile kuidagi eksamihinnet ära panna. Jüri ajab oma paindumatusega kogu suguvõsa ja ka naabrid hulluks. Tema pärast on ohus naabrite pulmad ja üldse kogu edaspidine suhtlus.

programme.title: Kired
programme.desc: Sarja peategelasteks on kaks abielupaari, kelle suhted muudab keeruliseks ühe paari naise ja teise paari mehe vahel puhkenud kirg. 1998. aastal TV3 eetris jooksma hakanud seriaali stsenaariumi autorid olid Aita Kivi, Juhan Habicht ja Stella K. Wadowsky, toimetaja Tiina Lokk, näitejuht Rein Oja, režissöörid Toomas Kirss ja Kalev Lepik. Peaosadesmängisid Merle Palmiste, Marika Vernik, Ita Ever, Märt Visnapuu ja Ivo Uukkivi. Produtsent oli Toomas Kirss.

programme.title: Kurjuse kannul
programme.desc: FBI kõige kogenumatest uurijatest ning profileerijatest koostatud meeskond lahendab ränki kuritegusid, mis esmapilgul tunduvad väljapääsmatult keerukad. Meeskonna iga liige on oma valdkonna tipp ning üksteist täendades pole ükski kuritegu neile lahendamatu.

programme.title: Mõrvaennetajad
programme.desc: Avahooajal USAs laineid löönud põnevussari salapärasest miljardärist, kes värbab endale appi endise CIA agendi, et ühiselt ennetada New Yorki ähvardavaid ränki kuritegusid. Pururikas geenius Finch ("Teadmata kadunud" staar Michael Emerson) on välja töötanud arvutiprogrammi, mis suudab tuvastada potentsiaalse mõrvari või tema ohvri veel enne selle kuriteo reaalset toimumist. Endine eriagent Reese (Jim Caviezel), kes pärast isiklikku tragöödiat elab New Yorkis kodutuna, on nõus Fichiga kampa lööma ja aitab Finchil huvipakkuva isiku üles leida. Reese'i ülesandeks jääb ka tulevase tapja kahjutuks tegemine. Loomulikult peab tandem tegutsema ülima saladuskatte all, sest nende info ja tegevuse paljastamise tagajärjed oleksid katastroofilised.

programme.desc: CSI meeskond uurib mõrva, mis puudutab Folsomi lähedalt. Kui ta sunnitakse juurdluse juurest taanduma, ei saa ta teisiti, kui ta peab omal käel juhtumiga edasi tegelema.

programme.title: Monk
programme.desc: Adrian Monk on üks San Francisco politseijaoskonna parimaid töötajaid, kuid pärast abikaasa traagilist surma on kõik muutunud: andekast detektiivist sai üleöö ettearvamatu ja impulsiivne inimene, kellel on ebanormaalsed hirmud ja kes ärritub väga kergesti. Sellest hoolimata püüab Monk oma tööd edasi teha, kuid sellel on ettearvamatud tagajärjed.

programme.title: Surmarelv
programme.desc: Legendaarsetel "Surmarelva" filmidel põhinev veriväske action-komöödiasari toob taas kokku kinoajaloo vingeima detektiivide paari! Oma naist leinav endine eriüksuslane Martin Riggs (Clayne Crawford) ja pärast infarkti tööle naasev Roger Murtaugh (Damon Wayans) moodustavad üdini vastandliku, aga ometi ideaalselt toimiva tandemi. Nende koostöö algus on okkaline, sest ohjeldamatu Riggsi pea-ees-tulle-sööstmise suhtumine põrkub vaoshoitud Murtaugh arusaamadega. Esimese ühise juhtumi lõppedes mõistavad aga mõlemad, et on lisaks uuele paarimehele leidnud endale ka parima sõbra.

programme.desc: Kui Sarah' sõber saab rünnakus vigastada ja langeb koomasse, sõidab Sarah Torontosse, et tema naiselt aru pärida. Charlie ja Rex leiavad kahtlusaluseid kodule lähemalt.

programme.title: Monk
programme.desc: Adrian Monk on üks San Francisco politseijaoskonna parimaid töötajaid, kuid pärast abikaasa traagilist surma on kõik muutunud: andekast detektiivist sai üleöö ettearvamatu ja impulsiivne inimene, kellel on ebanormaalsed hirmud ja kes ärritub väga kergesti. Sellest hoolimata püüab Monk oma tööd edasi teha, kuid sellel on ettearvamatud tagajärjed.

programme.title: Chicago politseijaoskond
programme.desc: Burgess peab otsustama, kas kuulab Voighti või võimalikku uut liitlast, kui patrulliga kaasasõit kiiva kisub.

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: CSI meeskond uurib mõrva, mis puudutab Folsomi lähedalt. Kui ta sunnitakse juurdluse juurest taanduma, ei saa ta teisiti, kui ta peab omal käel juhtumiga edasi tegelema.

programme.title: Mõrvaennetajad
programme.desc: Avahooajal USAs laineid löönud põnevussari salapärasest miljardärist, kes värbab endale appi endise CIA agendi, et ühiselt ennetada New Yorki ähvardavaid ränki kuritegusid. Pururikas geenius Finch ("Teadmata kadunud" staar Michael Emerson) on välja töötanud arvutiprogrammi, mis suudab tuvastada potentsiaalse mõrvari või tema ohvri veel enne selle kuriteo reaalset toimumist. Endine eriagent Reese (Jim Caviezel), kes pärast isiklikku tragöödiat elab New Yorkis kodutuna, on nõus Fichiga kampa lööma ja aitab Finchil huvipakkuva isiku üles leida. Reese'i ülesandeks jääb ka tulevase tapja kahjutuks tegemine. Loomulikult peab tandem tegutsema ülima saladuskatte all, sest nende info ja tegevuse paljastamise tagajärjed oleksid katastroofilised.

programme.title: Tark mees taskus
programme.desc: Ekstsentriline raamatupoe omanik ja endine spioon Book aitab 1950. aastate Londonis politseil keerulisi mõrvu lahendada. Noor endine vang Jack asub poes tööle ja saab sooja vastuvõtu osaliseks, ent hakkab peagi kahtlustama, et teda ei värvatud juhuslikult.

programme.title: Kurjuse kannul
programme.desc: FBI kõige kogenumatest uurijatest ning profileerijatest koostatud meeskond lahendab ränki kuritegusid, mis esmapilgul tunduvad väljapääsmatult keerukad. Meeskonna iga liige on oma valdkonna tipp ning üksteist täendades pole ükski kuritegu neile lahendamatu.

programme.title: Surmarelv
programme.desc: Legendaarsetel "Surmarelva" filmidel põhinev veriväske action-komöödiasari toob taas kokku kinoajaloo vingeima detektiivide paari! Oma naist leinav endine eriüksuslane Martin Riggs (Clayne Crawford) ja pärast infarkti tööle naasev Roger Murtaugh (Damon Wayans) moodustavad üdini vastandliku, aga ometi ideaalselt toimiva tandemi. Nende koostöö algus on okkaline, sest ohjeldamatu Riggsi pea-ees-tulle-sööstmise suhtumine põrkub vaoshoitud Murtaugh arusaamadega. Esimese ühise juhtumi lõppedes mõistavad aga mõlemad, et on lisaks uuele paarimehele leidnud endale ka parima sõbra.

programme.title: Sue ja Mike
programme.desc: Romantiline komöödia eduka ärinaise ja lihtsa motellitöötaja ootamatust armuloost. Jäine kaunitar Sue (Jennifer Aniston) ja romantiline unistaja Mike ei anna kaugeltki ideaalpaari mõõtu välja. Sellest hoolimata otsustab Mike naise südame vallutada, ehkki esialgu ei suuda ta ühtki toimivat võrgutusnippi leida... Film ei sobi alaealistele.

programme.title: Suhete mänguväljak
programme.desc: Jalgpallurist südametemurdja satub saatuse tahtel laste jalgpallimeeskonna treeneriks. Sellest hetkest muutub jalgpalliplats tema hoolealuste ja nende veetlevate emade suhete mänguväljakuks.

programme.title: Põgenev pruut
programme.desc: Romantiline draama väikelinna iludusest Maggi Carpenterist (Julia Roberts), kes armastab hirmsal kombel pulmakleidis altari ette kõndida ent siis põgeneda. Tavaliselt lõpeb jalutuskäik altarini laulatusega, kuid Maggie'ga juba nii ei juhtu - tema on juba kolm korda altari ette jõudnud ja täpselt samapalju kordi sealt tuhatnelja põgenenud ja kõik peiud pika ninaga jätnud. Argpüks? Meestesolgutaja? Vastuse jahil saabub väikelinna Ike Graham (Richard Gere) - New Yorgi reporter, kes soovib veidrast pulmapõgenikust loo kirjutada.

programme.title: Kiirperekond
programme.desc: Kiirperekond on moodne ja emotsionaalne komöödia, mis jutustab loo Elliest (Rose Byrne) ja Pete'ist (Mark Wahlberg), kes otsustavad saada kasuvanemateks. Teinud algust lapsendamisprotsessiga ja valides potentsiaalset kasvandikku, tekib neil endalegi üllatuseks hea side ühe iseteadliku 15-aastase tüdrukuga (Isabela Moner). Kuid siis selgub, et ninakal teismelisel on ka nunnu pisiõde ja väikevend ning enne veel kui Ellie ja Pete saavad aru oma valiku tagajärgedest, on nad lapsendanud kamba põngerjaid, kel pole mingit huvi saada hästi kasvatatud lasteks.

programme.title: Koonuspead
programme.desc: Tulnukapaar ja nende tütar teevad Maal hädamaandumise ja üritavad sulanduda äärelinna ühiskonda.

programme.title: Minu endine superpruut
programme.desc: Matt Saundersi (Wilson) arvates on Jenny Johnson (Thurman) tema jaoks ideaalne pruut, sest naine on nutikas, seksikas ning juhtumisi ka superkangelane. Kui Jenny aga armukadedaks neurootikuks osutub, tahab Matt ta maha jätta. Naisele see uudis muidugi ei meeldi ja ta otsustab iga hinna eest kätte maksta. See superkomöödia tõestab, et lahkuminek on väga raske ning võib osutuda lausa eluohtlikuks!

programme.title: Napoleon Dynamite
programme.desc: Ükskõikne ja kõigist võõrandunud teismeline otsustab aidata uuel sõbral saada klassivanemaks. Samal ajal jagab sõber maid koju jäänud veidrikest pereliikmetega.

programme.title: Casper
programme.desc: Joonisfilmil põhinev koguperemuinasjutt sugugi mitte hirmuäratava kummituse seiklustest ja sõprusest väikese tüdrukuga.

programme.title: Tagasi Maa peal
programme.desc: Mustanahaline koomik sureb enne õiget aega ning saab valge ärimehe kehas uue võimaluse.

programme.title: Ja nii ma abiellusin kirvemõrvariga
programme.desc: Suhtefoobikust San Francisco poeet leiab lõpuks oma äravalitu, kuid siis hakkab ta uskuma, et naine on kirvega sarimõrvar.

programme.title: Juno
programme.desc: Parima stsenaariumi Oscari ja terve hulga teiste filmiauhindadega pärjatud kaasahaarav ja südamlik draama. Juno on 16-aastane keskkoolitüdruk, kes jääb ootamatult oma klassivennast rasedaks. Juno, kes on terane ja hakkaja tüdruk, otsustab lapse sünnitada ja ta mõnda toredasse peresse lapsendada anda. Neiu leiab suurepärase paari, kellele oma laps anda, ja jätkab hoolimata kasvavast kõhust kooliteed. Kuid siis selgub, et tulevaste ideaalsete lapsevanemate suhe polegi nii roosiline nagu esialgu paistis… Mängivad Ellen Paige ("Algus"), Jennifer Garner ("Alias"), J.K. Simmons ("Whiplash") jt.

programme.title: Jackass: trikke hulludele!
programme.desc: Johnny Knoxville ja tema maniakaalsed kaaslased teevad suurel ekraanil uusi trikke ja okseleajavaid paljastusi.

programme.desc: Kaks teineteisest võõrdunud soulilegendi nõustuvad osalema kokkutulekul New Yorgi Apollo teatris, et austada hiljuti surnud bändijuhti.

programme.title: Holly Hobbie
programme.desc: Holly Hobbie on kogu elu elanud linnakeses nimega Collinsville. Holly on laulja ja laulukirjutaja, kellel on parimad sõbrad ja armastav perekond, kuid kes unistab maailma päästmisest, isegi kui see tähendab oma aiast alustamist.

programme.title: Hoodie
programme.desc: "Hoodie" on superkangelase lugu täiesti tavalisest poisist, kellel on erakordne parkuuri talent ja õiglustunne. Nüüd on ta juba kaks aastat harjutanud parkuurimist Soufianiga, Brüsseli parima jäljekütiga. Ta teeb seda salaja, sest tema ema, innukas politseinik, ei kiidaks seda iial heaks. Kui kolm naabruskonna last Flo, Basim ja Kenza avastavad Pieteri talendi ja motivatsiooni, ühinevad nad ootamatuks superkangelaste tiimiks nimega tiim Hoodie. Neid ühendab üks eesmärk - vabastada naabruskond ülekohtust.
